class Policy: 
23class Policy:
24    """Policy interface: $$u = \\pi_\\theta(x)$$ with gradient $$\\partial u / \\partial \\theta$$."""
25
26    def theta_dim(self, state_dim: int) -> int:
27        """Return required theta dimension for inputs with ``state_dim`` columns."""
28        raise NotImplementedError
29
30    def value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
31        """Return action values for batch, shape (n_samples,)."""
32        raise NotImplementedError
33
34    def grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
35        """Return policy gradients for batch, shape (n_samples, theta_dim)."""
36        raise NotImplementedError
37
38    def weighted_grad(
39        self,
40        theta: np.ndarray,
41        x_batch: np.ndarray,
42        weights: np.ndarray,
43    ) -> np.ndarray:
44        """Return ``sum_i weights_i * d pi_theta(x_i) / d theta``."""
45        policy_grad = self.grad(theta, x_batch)
46        weights_arr = np.asarray(weights, dtype=float)
47        if weights_arr.ndim != 1:
48            raise ValueError("weights must be a 1D array.")
49        if weights_arr.shape != (policy_grad.shape[0],):
50            raise ValueError("weights must have one value per x_batch row.")
51        return np.einsum("n,nd->d", weights_arr, policy_grad)

def sample_states( rng: numpy.random._generator.Generator, n: int, dim: int) -> numpy.ndarray: 
16def sample_states(rng: np.random.Generator, n: int, dim: int) -> np.ndarray:
17    """Sample n state vectors from $$\\mathcal{N}(0, I)$$, shape (n, dim)."""
18    if n <= 0 or dim <= 0:
19        raise ValueError("n and dim must be positive.")
20    return rng.normal(0.0, 1.0, size=(n, dim)).astype(float)

203@dataclass(frozen=True)
204class CallableFeatureMap(FeatureMap):
205    """Validated adapter for a user-supplied state feature callable."""

212    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
213        if not callable(self.fn):

216            raise ValueError("feature_dim must be positive.")
217
218    def transform(self, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
219        """Apply and validate the wrapped feature-map callable."""
220        x_arr = _as_2d_float_array(x_batch)
221        features = self.fn(x_arr)
222        return _validate_feature_output(features, x_arr, expected_dim=int(self.feature_dim))
223
224    def output_dim(self, state_dim: int) -> int:
225        """Return the declared callable output width."""
226        _validate_state_dim(state_dim)
227        return int(self.feature_dim)

class ConstantPolicy(objective.Policy): 
268@dataclass(frozen=True)
269class ConstantPolicy(Policy):
270    """Constant policy: $$u = \\theta_0$$, ignores state $$x$$."""
271
272    kind: str = _POLICY_CONSTANT
273
274    def theta_dim(self, state_dim: int) -> int:
275        """Return the one scalar parameter used by the constant policy."""
276        _validate_state_dim(state_dim)
277        return 1
278
279    def value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
280        """Return constant action for all samples, shape (n_samples,)."""
281        x_arr = _as_2d_float_array(x_batch)
282        theta_arr = _validate_theta(theta, expected_dim=1)
283        return np.full(x_arr.shape[0], float(theta_arr[0]), dtype=float)
284
285    def grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
286        """Return gradient [1] for all samples, shape (n_samples, 1)."""
287        x_arr = _as_2d_float_array(x_batch)
288        _validate_theta(theta, expected_dim=1)
289        grad = np.zeros((x_arr.shape[0], 1), dtype=float)
290        grad[:, 0] = 1.0
291        return grad
292
293    def weighted_grad(
294        self,
295        theta: np.ndarray,
296        x_batch: np.ndarray,
297        weights: np.ndarray,
298    ) -> np.ndarray:
299        """Return weighted policy-gradient sum without materializing a Jacobian."""
300        x_arr = _as_2d_float_array(x_batch)
301        _validate_theta(theta, expected_dim=1)
302        weights_arr = _validate_weights(weights, x_arr.shape[0])
303        return np.asarray([float(np.sum(weights_arr))], dtype=float)

Constant policy: $$u = \theta_0$$, ignores state $$x$$.

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CubicFeatureMap(objective.FeatureMap): 
163@dataclass(frozen=True)
164class CubicFeatureMap(FeatureMap):
165    """Cubic map with linear terms and exact degree-3 monomials."""
166
167    include_interactions: bool = True
168    kind: str = "cubic"
169
170    def transform(self, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
171        """Return ``[x, x_i*x_j*x_k for i <= j <= k]`` features for each sample."""
172        x_arr = _as_2d_float_array(x_batch)
173        if not np.isfinite(x_arr).all():
174            raise ValueError("x_batch must contain finite values.")
175        degree_terms = _exact_degree_products(x_arr, 3) if self.include_interactions else x_arr**3
176        return np.concatenate([x_arr, degree_terms], axis=1).astype(float)
177
178    def output_dim(self, state_dim: int) -> int:
179        """Return cubic feature width excluding the policy intercept."""
180        return _exact_degree_output_dim(state_dim, 3, include_interactions=self.include_interactions)

321        return (features @ theta_arr).astype(float)
322

324        """Return gradient phi(x) for all samples, shape (n_samples, theta_dim)."""

327        return features

336        features = _phi(x_batch, self.feature_map)
337        _validate_theta(theta, expected_dim=features.shape[1])
338        weights_arr = _validate_weights(weights, features.shape[0])
339        return features.T @ weights_arr

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MLPPolicy(objective.Policy): 
402@dataclass(frozen=True)
403class MLPPolicy(Policy):
404    """Two-layer MLP policy with bounded action $$u = 0.5 - \\sigma(z) \\in (-0.5, 0.5)$$.
405
406    Architecture: $$\\varphi(x) \\to \\text{Linear}(d_{in} \\to H) \\to \\tanh \\to \\text{Linear}(H \\to H) \\to \\tanh \\to \\text{Linear}(H \\to 1) \\to 0.5 - \\sigma(\\cdot)$$.
407    Theta is the flat concatenation of ``[W1, b1, W2, b2, W3, b3]`` row-major.
408    The MLP has explicit biases, so the feature map output is consumed directly
409    (no intercept column is prepended).
410    """
411
412    feature_map: FeatureMap = field(default_factory=IdentityFeatureMap)
413    hidden: int = 16
414    kind: str = _POLICY_MLP
415
416    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
417        if int(self.hidden) <= 0:
418            raise ValueError("hidden must be positive.")
419
420    def theta_dim(self, state_dim: int) -> int:
421        """Return ``d_in*H + H + H*H + H + H + 1`` where ``d_in = dim(varphi(x))``."""
422        d_in = self.feature_map.output_dim(state_dim)
423        return self._theta_dim_from_d_in(d_in)
424
425    def _theta_dim_from_d_in(self, d_in: int) -> int:
426        H = int(self.hidden)
427        return d_in * H + H + H * H + H + H + 1
428
429    def _unpack(
430        self, theta: np.ndarray, d_in: int
431    ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
432        H = int(self.hidden)
433        idx = 0
434        W1 = theta[idx : idx + d_in * H].reshape(d_in, H)
435        idx += d_in * H
436        b1 = theta[idx : idx + H]
437        idx += H
438        W2 = theta[idx : idx + H * H].reshape(H, H)
439        idx += H * H
440        b2 = theta[idx : idx + H]
441        idx += H
442        W3 = theta[idx : idx + H].reshape(H, 1)
443        idx += H
444        b3 = theta[idx : idx + 1]
445        return W1, b1, W2, b2, W3, b3
446
447    def _features(self, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
448        x_arr = _as_2d_float_array(x_batch)
449        if not np.isfinite(x_arr).all():
450            raise ValueError("x_batch must contain finite values.")
451        features = self.feature_map.transform(x_arr)
452        return _validate_feature_output(features, x_arr)
453
454    def value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
455        """Return MLP action values, shape ``(n_samples,)``."""
456        phi = self._features(x_batch)
457        d_in = phi.shape[1]
458        theta_arr = _validate_theta(theta, expected_dim=self._theta_dim_from_d_in(d_in))
459        W1, b1, W2, b2, W3, b3 = self._unpack(theta_arr, d_in)
460        h1 = np.tanh(phi @ W1 + b1)
461        h2 = np.tanh(h1 @ W2 + b2)
462        z3 = (h2 @ W3 + b3).ravel()
463        return (0.5 - _sigmoid(z3)).astype(float)
464
465    def grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
466        """Return Jacobian ``du/dtheta``, shape ``(n_samples, theta_dim)``, via manual backprop."""
467        phi = self._features(x_batch)
468        n_samples, d_in = phi.shape
469        H = int(self.hidden)
470        theta_arr = _validate_theta(theta, expected_dim=self._theta_dim_from_d_in(d_in))
471        W1, b1, W2, b2, W3, b3 = self._unpack(theta_arr, d_in)
472
473        # Forward (cached)
474        z1 = phi @ W1 + b1
475        h1 = np.tanh(z1)
476        z2 = h1 @ W2 + b2
477        h2 = np.tanh(z2)
478        z3 = (h2 @ W3 + b3).ravel()
479        sigma = _sigmoid(z3)
480        du_dz3 = -sigma * (1.0 - sigma)  # (n,)
481
482        # Layer 3: z3 = h2 @ W3 + b3, W3 has shape (H, 1)
483        dW3_flat = du_dz3[:, None] * h2  # (n, H) — matches W3.ravel() row-major over (H, 1)
484        db3_flat = du_dz3[:, None]  # (n, 1)
485
486        # Layer 2: backprop tanh, z2 = h1 @ W2 + b2
487        dh2 = du_dz3[:, None] * W3.ravel()[None, :]  # (n, H)
488        dz2 = dh2 * (1.0 - h2 * h2)  # (n, H)
489        dW2 = h1[:, :, None] * dz2[:, None, :]  # (n, H, H), W2 row-major: idx = j*H + k
490        dW2_flat = dW2.reshape(n_samples, H * H)
491        db2_flat = dz2  # (n, H)
492
493        # Layer 1: backprop tanh, z1 = phi @ W1 + b1
494        dh1 = dz2 @ W2.T  # (n, H)
495        dz1 = dh1 * (1.0 - h1 * h1)  # (n, H)
496        dW1 = phi[:, :, None] * dz1[:, None, :]  # (n, d_in, H), W1 row-major: idx = j*H + k
497        dW1_flat = dW1.reshape(n_samples, d_in * H)
498        db1_flat = dz1  # (n, H)
499
500        return np.concatenate(
501            [dW1_flat, db1_flat, dW2_flat, db2_flat, dW3_flat, db3_flat],
502            axis=1,
503        )
504
505    def weighted_grad(
506        self,
507        theta: np.ndarray,
508        x_batch: np.ndarray,
509        weights: np.ndarray,
510    ) -> np.ndarray:
511        """Return weighted policy-gradient sum by reverse-mode batch backprop."""
512        phi = self._features(x_batch)
513        n_samples, d_in = phi.shape
514        H = int(self.hidden)
515        theta_arr = _validate_theta(theta, expected_dim=self._theta_dim_from_d_in(d_in))
516        weights_arr = _validate_weights(weights, n_samples)
517        W1, b1, W2, b2, W3, b3 = self._unpack(theta_arr, d_in)
518
519        z1 = phi @ W1 + b1
520        h1 = np.tanh(z1)
521        z2 = h1 @ W2 + b2
522        h2 = np.tanh(z2)
523        z3 = (h2 @ W3 + b3).ravel()
524        sigma = _sigmoid(z3)
525        dz3 = weights_arr * (-sigma * (1.0 - sigma))
526
527        dW3 = h2.T @ dz3[:, None]
528        db3 = np.asarray([float(np.sum(dz3))], dtype=float)
529
530        dh2 = dz3[:, None] * W3.ravel()[None, :]
531        dz2 = dh2 * (1.0 - h2 * h2)
532        dW2 = h1.T @ dz2
533        db2 = np.sum(dz2, axis=0)
534
535        dh1 = dz2 @ W2.T
536        dz1 = dh1 * (1.0 - h1 * h1)
537        dW1 = phi.T @ dz1
538        db1 = np.sum(dz1, axis=0)
539
540        return np.concatenate(
541            [dW1.ravel(), db1, dW2.ravel(), db2, dW3.ravel(), db3],
542        ).astype(float)

Two-layer MLP policy with bounded action $$u = 0.5 - \sigma(z) \in (-0.5, 0.5)$$.

Theta is the flat concatenation of [W1, b1, W2, b2, W3, b3] row-major. The MLP has explicit biases, so the feature map output is consumed directly (no intercept column is prepended).

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class QuadraticFeatureMap(objective.FeatureMap): 
133@dataclass(frozen=True)
134class QuadraticFeatureMap(FeatureMap):
135    """Quadratic map with linear terms and upper-triangular pair products."""
136
137    include_interactions: bool = True
138    kind: str = "quadratic"
139
140    def transform(self, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
141        """Return ``[x, x_i*x_j for i <= j]`` features for each sample."""
142        x_arr = _as_2d_float_array(x_batch)
143        if not np.isfinite(x_arr).all():
144            raise ValueError("x_batch must contain finite values.")
145        n_samples, state_dim = x_arr.shape
146        cols = [x_arr]
147        if self.include_interactions:
148            row_idx, col_idx = np.triu_indices(state_dim)
149            cols.append(x_arr[:, row_idx] * x_arr[:, col_idx])
150        else:
151            cols.append(x_arr * x_arr)
152        if not cols:
153            return np.empty((n_samples, 0), dtype=float)

160        return dim + quadratic_dim

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SoftmaxPolicy(objective.Policy): 
342@dataclass(frozen=True)
343class SoftmaxPolicy(Policy):
344    """Bounded sigmoid policy: $$u = l + (h-l)\\sigma(\\theta^\\top \\phi(x))$$."""
345
346    feature_map: FeatureMap = field(default_factory=IdentityFeatureMap)
347    action_low: float = -0.5
348    action_high: float = 0.5
349    kind: str = _POLICY_SOFTMAX
350
351    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
352        low = float(self.action_low)
353        high = float(self.action_high)
354        if not np.isfinite(low) or not np.isfinite(high):
355            raise ValueError("SoftmaxPolicy action bounds must be finite.")
356        if low >= high:
357            raise ValueError("SoftmaxPolicy requires action_low < action_high.")
358        object.__setattr__(self, "action_low", low)
359        object.__setattr__(self, "action_high", high)
360
361    def theta_dim(self, state_dim: int) -> int:
362        """Return ``1 + dim(varphi(x))`` for this policy's feature map."""
363        return _theta_dim(self.feature_map, state_dim)
364
365    def value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
366        """Return softmax action values, shape (n_samples,)."""
367        features = _phi(x_batch, self.feature_map)
368        theta_arr = _validate_theta(theta, expected_dim=features.shape[1])
369        z = features @ theta_arr
370        return (self.action_low + self.action_span * _sigmoid(z)).astype(float)
371
372    def grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
373        """Return ``du/dtheta`` for all samples, shape ``(n_samples, theta_dim)``."""
374        features = _phi(x_batch, self.feature_map)
375        theta_arr = _validate_theta(theta, expected_dim=features.shape[1])
376        z = features @ theta_arr
377        sigma = _sigmoid(z)
378        du_dz = self.action_span * sigma * (1.0 - sigma)
379        return du_dz[:, None] * features
380
381    def weighted_grad(
382        self,
383        theta: np.ndarray,
384        x_batch: np.ndarray,
385        weights: np.ndarray,
386    ) -> np.ndarray:
387        """Return weighted policy-gradient sum without materializing a Jacobian."""
388        features = _phi(x_batch, self.feature_map)
389        theta_arr = _validate_theta(theta, expected_dim=features.shape[1])
390        weights_arr = _validate_weights(weights, features.shape[0])
391        z = features @ theta_arr
392        sigma = _sigmoid(z)
393        du_dz = self.action_span * sigma * (1.0 - sigma)
394        return features.T @ (weights_arr * du_dz)
395
396    @property
397    def action_span(self) -> float:
398        """Return ``action_high - action_low``."""
399        return float(self.action_high - self.action_low)

Bounded sigmoid policy: $$u = l + (h-l)\sigma(\theta^\top \phi(x))$$.

def mlp_init_theta( rng: numpy.random._generator.Generator, *, d_in: int, hidden: int = 16) -> numpy.ndarray: 
545def mlp_init_theta(rng: np.random.Generator, *, d_in: int, hidden: int = 16) -> np.ndarray:
546    """Glorot-uniform init for an `MLPPolicy` of the given input/hidden width.
547
548    `d_in` is the post-feature-map input width (e.g., the value returned by
549    `feature_map.output_dim(state_dim)` or `acceptance_model.policy_feature_dim()`).
550    Biases are initialized to zero.
551    """
552    d_in_int = int(d_in)
553    H = int(hidden)
554    if d_in_int <= 0:
555        raise ValueError("d_in must be positive.")
556    if H <= 0:
557        raise ValueError("hidden must be positive.")
558
559    def _glorot(fan_in: int, fan_out: int) -> np.ndarray:
560        scale = float(np.sqrt(6.0 / (fan_in + fan_out)))
561        return rng.uniform(-scale, scale, size=(fan_in, fan_out))
562
563    W1 = _glorot(d_in_int, H)
564    b1 = np.zeros(H, dtype=float)
565    W2 = _glorot(H, H)
566    b2 = np.zeros(H, dtype=float)
567    W3 = _glorot(H, 1)
568    b3 = np.zeros(1, dtype=float)
569    return np.concatenate(
570        [W1.ravel(), b1, W2.ravel(), b2, W3.ravel(), b3]
571    ).astype(float)

622        return ConstantPolicy()
623    if kind == _POLICY_LINEAR:
624        return LinearPolicy()
625    if kind == _POLICY_SOFTMAX:

629    raise ValueError(f"Policy kind must be one of {_POLICY_KINDS}.")

@dataclass
class PolicyFeaturePreprocessor: 
 11@dataclass
 12class PolicyFeaturePreprocessor:
 13    """Fit-once standardization, whitening, and optional PCA for policy inputs."""
 14
 15    standardize: bool = True
 16    sphere: bool = True
 17    pca_dim: int | None = None
 18    regularization: float = 1e-6
 19
 20    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
 21        if self.pca_dim is not None and int(self.pca_dim) <= 0:
 22            raise ValueError("pca_dim must be positive or None.")
 23        if float(self.regularization) <= 0.0:
 24            raise ValueError("regularization must be positive.")
 25        self.pca_dim = None if self.pca_dim is None else int(self.pca_dim)
 26        self.regularization = float(self.regularization)
 27
 28    def fit(self, x_raw: np.ndarray) -> "PolicyFeaturePreprocessor":
 29        """Fit preprocessing statistics on a fixed raw policy-state matrix."""
 30        x_arr = _as_2d_float_array(x_raw)
 31        n_features = x_arr.shape[1]
 32        if self.pca_dim is not None and self.pca_dim > n_features:
 33            raise ValueError(
 34                f"pca_dim={self.pca_dim} exceeds input dimension {n_features}."
 35            )
 36
 37        self.input_dim_ = n_features
 38        self.mean_ = x_arr.mean(axis=0) if self.standardize else np.zeros(n_features)
 39        centered = x_arr - self.mean_
 40        scale = centered.std(axis=0) if self.standardize else np.ones(n_features)
 41        self.scale_ = np.where(scale > 0.0, scale, 1.0)
 42        normalized = centered / self.scale_
 43
 44        if self.sphere or self.pca_dim is not None:
 45            cov = np.cov(normalized, rowvar=False)
 46            if np.ndim(cov) == 0:
 47                cov = np.array([[float(cov)]])
 48            eigvals, eigvecs = np.linalg.eigh(cov)
 49            order = np.argsort(eigvals)[::-1]
 50            eigvals = np.maximum(eigvals[order], self.regularization)
 51            eigvecs = eigvecs[:, order]
 52        else:
 53            eigvals = np.ones(n_features, dtype=float)
 54            eigvecs = np.eye(n_features, dtype=float)
 55
 56        self.eigenvalues_ = eigvals
 57        total_var = float(eigvals.sum())
 58        self.explained_variance_ratio_ = eigvals / total_var if total_var > 0.0 else eigvals
 59        self.cumulative_variance_ratio_ = np.cumsum(self.explained_variance_ratio_)
 60
 61        n_keep = n_features if self.pca_dim is None else self.pca_dim
 62        self.output_dim_ = n_keep
 63        components = eigvecs[:, :n_keep]
 64        if self.sphere:
 65            scale_keep = 1.0 / np.sqrt(eigvals[:n_keep])
 66            self.transform_matrix_ = components @ np.diag(scale_keep)
 67        else:
 68            self.transform_matrix_ = components
 69        self.output_feature_names_ = [f"policy_pc{i + 1}" for i in range(n_keep)]
 70        return self
 71
 72    def transform(self, x_raw: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 73        """Apply fitted preprocessing to raw policy-state rows."""
 74        if not hasattr(self, "transform_matrix_"):
 75            raise ValueError("PolicyFeaturePreprocessor is not fitted. Call fit() first.")
 76        x_arr = _as_2d_float_array(x_raw)
 77        if x_arr.shape[1] != self.input_dim_:
 78            raise ValueError(
 79                f"Expected {self.input_dim_} input columns, got {x_arr.shape[1]}."
 80            )
 81        normalized = (x_arr - self.mean_) / self.scale_
 82        return np.asarray(normalized @ self.transform_matrix_, dtype=float)
 83
 84    def fit_transform(self, x_raw: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 85        """Fit and transform the same raw policy-state matrix."""
 86        return self.fit(x_raw).transform(x_raw)
 87
 88    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
 89        """Serialize preprocessing settings and fitted dimensionality metadata."""
 90        return {
 91            "standardize": bool(self.standardize),
 92            "sphere": bool(self.sphere),
 93            "pca_dim": self.pca_dim,
 94            "regularization": float(self.regularization),
 95            "input_dim": int(getattr(self, "input_dim_", 0)),
 96            "output_dim": int(getattr(self, "output_dim_", 0)),
 97            "output_feature_names": list(getattr(self, "output_feature_names_", ())),
 98        }
 99
100    def to_state(self) -> dict[str, object]:
101        """Return metadata and fitted arrays needed to replay this transform exactly."""
102        if not hasattr(self, "transform_matrix_"):
103            raise ValueError("PolicyFeaturePreprocessor is not fitted. Call fit() first.")
104        return {
105            "metadata": self.to_dict(),
106            "arrays": {
107                "mean": np.asarray(self.mean_, dtype=float),
108                "scale": np.asarray(self.scale_, dtype=float),
109                "eigenvalues": np.asarray(self.eigenvalues_, dtype=float),
110                "explained_variance_ratio": np.asarray(self.explained_variance_ratio_, dtype=float),
111                "cumulative_variance_ratio": np.asarray(self.cumulative_variance_ratio_, dtype=float),
112                "transform_matrix": np.asarray(self.transform_matrix_, dtype=float),
113            },
114        }
115
116    @classmethod
117    def from_state(
118        cls,
119        metadata: dict[str, object],
120        arrays: dict[str, np.ndarray],
121    ) -> "PolicyFeaturePreprocessor":
122        """Restore a fitted preprocessor from ``to_state`` metadata and arrays."""
123        preprocessor = cls(
124            standardize=bool(metadata.get("standardize", True)),
125            sphere=bool(metadata.get("sphere", True)),
126            pca_dim=metadata.get("pca_dim"),
127            regularization=float(metadata.get("regularization", 1e-6)),
128        )
129        required = (
130            "mean",
131            "scale",
132            "eigenvalues",
133            "explained_variance_ratio",
134            "cumulative_variance_ratio",
135            "transform_matrix",
136        )
137        missing = [name for name in required if name not in arrays]
138        if missing:
139            raise ValueError(f"Missing policy preprocessor state arrays: {missing}")
140        preprocessor.input_dim_ = int(metadata["input_dim"])
141        preprocessor.output_dim_ = int(metadata["output_dim"])
142        preprocessor.output_feature_names_ = [
143            str(name) for name in metadata.get("output_feature_names", ())
144        ]
145        preprocessor.mean_ = np.asarray(arrays["mean"], dtype=float)
146        preprocessor.scale_ = np.asarray(arrays["scale"], dtype=float)
147        preprocessor.eigenvalues_ = np.asarray(arrays["eigenvalues"], dtype=float)
148        preprocessor.explained_variance_ratio_ = np.asarray(
149            arrays["explained_variance_ratio"], dtype=float
150        )
151        preprocessor.cumulative_variance_ratio_ = np.asarray(
152            arrays["cumulative_variance_ratio"], dtype=float
153        )
154        preprocessor.transform_matrix_ = np.asarray(arrays["transform_matrix"], dtype=float)
155        if preprocessor.mean_.shape != (preprocessor.input_dim_,):
156            raise ValueError("Restored policy preprocessor mean has invalid shape.")
157        if preprocessor.scale_.shape != (preprocessor.input_dim_,):
158            raise ValueError("Restored policy preprocessor scale has invalid shape.")
159        if preprocessor.transform_matrix_.shape != (preprocessor.input_dim_, preprocessor.output_dim_):
160            raise ValueError("Restored policy preprocessor transform matrix has invalid shape.")
161        return preprocessor

111                "cumulative_variance_ratio": np.asarray(self.cumulative_variance_ratio_, dtype=float),
112                "transform_matrix": np.asarray(self.transform_matrix_, dtype=float),
113            },
114        }

@classmethod
def from_state( cls, metadata: dict[str, object], arrays: dict[str, numpy.ndarray]) -> PolicyFeaturePreprocessor: 
116    @classmethod
117    def from_state(
118        cls,
119        metadata: dict[str, object],
120        arrays: dict[str, np.ndarray],
121    ) -> "PolicyFeaturePreprocessor":
122        """Restore a fitted preprocessor from ``to_state`` metadata and arrays."""
123        preprocessor = cls(
124            standardize=bool(metadata.get("standardize", True)),
125            sphere=bool(metadata.get("sphere", True)),
126            pca_dim=metadata.get("pca_dim"),
127            regularization=float(metadata.get("regularization", 1e-6)),
128        )
129        required = (
130            "mean",
131            "scale",
132            "eigenvalues",
133            "explained_variance_ratio",
134            "cumulative_variance_ratio",
135            "transform_matrix",
136        )
137        missing = [name for name in required if name not in arrays]
138        if missing:
139            raise ValueError(f"Missing policy preprocessor state arrays: {missing}")
140        preprocessor.input_dim_ = int(metadata["input_dim"])
141        preprocessor.output_dim_ = int(metadata["output_dim"])
142        preprocessor.output_feature_names_ = [
143            str(name) for name in metadata.get("output_feature_names", ())
144        ]
145        preprocessor.mean_ = np.asarray(arrays["mean"], dtype=float)
146        preprocessor.scale_ = np.asarray(arrays["scale"], dtype=float)
147        preprocessor.eigenvalues_ = np.asarray(arrays["eigenvalues"], dtype=float)
148        preprocessor.explained_variance_ratio_ = np.asarray(
149            arrays["explained_variance_ratio"], dtype=float
150        )
151        preprocessor.cumulative_variance_ratio_ = np.asarray(
152            arrays["cumulative_variance_ratio"], dtype=float
153        )
154        preprocessor.transform_matrix_ = np.asarray(arrays["transform_matrix"], dtype=float)
155        if preprocessor.mean_.shape != (preprocessor.input_dim_,):
156            raise ValueError("Restored policy preprocessor mean has invalid shape.")
157        if preprocessor.scale_.shape != (preprocessor.input_dim_,):
158            raise ValueError("Restored policy preprocessor scale has invalid shape.")
159        if preprocessor.transform_matrix_.shape != (preprocessor.input_dim_, preprocessor.output_dim_):
160            raise ValueError("Restored policy preprocessor transform matrix has invalid shape.")
161        return preprocessor

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FixedRegressionObjective(objective.Objective): 
 16@dataclass(frozen=True)
 17class FixedRegressionObjective(Objective):
 18    """Pricing objective: $$f(u; x) = a(x,u)(\\ell(x) - r(u))$$.
 19
 20    Components: $$a = \\sigma(\\beta_1^\\top x + \\beta_2 u)$$, $$\\ell = \\beta_3^\\top x$$, $$r = \\beta_4 u$$.
 21    Computes theta-gradients via chain rule through the attached policy.
 22    """
 23
 24    policy: Policy
 25    beta_1: np.ndarray
 26    beta_2: float
 27    beta_3: np.ndarray
 28    beta_4: float
 29
 30    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
 31        beta_1 = np.asarray(self.beta_1, dtype=float)
 32        beta_2 = float(self.beta_2)
 33        beta_3 = np.asarray(self.beta_3, dtype=float)
 34        beta_4 = float(self.beta_4)
 35        if np.any(beta_1 <= 0.0):
 36            raise ValueError("beta_1 entries must be positive.")
 37        if beta_2 >= 0.0:
 38            raise ValueError(
 39                "beta_2 must be negative; acceptance probability should decrease as policy value increases."
 40            )
 41        if np.any(beta_3 <= 0.0):
 42            raise ValueError("beta_3 entries must be positive.")
 43        if beta_4 <= 0.0:
 44            raise ValueError("beta_4 must be positive.")
 45        object.__setattr__(self, "beta_1", beta_1)
 46        object.__setattr__(self, "beta_2", beta_2)
 47        object.__setattr__(self, "beta_3", beta_3)
 48        object.__setattr__(self, "beta_4", beta_4)
 49
 50    @classmethod
 51    def from_parameters(
 52        cls,
 53        policy: Policy,
 54        beta_1: np.ndarray | Sequence[float],
 55        beta_2: float,
 56        beta_3: np.ndarray | Sequence[float],
 57        beta_4: float,
 58    ) -> "FixedRegressionObjective":
 59        """Create objective from parameter values."""
 60        return cls(
 61            policy=policy,
 62            beta_1=np.asarray(beta_1, dtype=float),
 63            beta_2=float(beta_2),
 64            beta_3=np.asarray(beta_3, dtype=float),
 65            beta_4=float(beta_4),
 66        )
 67
 68    def value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> float:
 69        """Compute mean objective value across batch."""
 70        x_arr = np.asarray(x_batch, dtype=float)
 71        if x_arr.ndim != 2:
 72            raise ValueError("x_batch must be a 2D array.")
 73        u_batch = self.policy.value(theta, x_arr)
 74        values = self._value_batch(x_arr, u_batch)
 75        return float(np.mean(values))
 76
 77    def grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 78        """Compute theta-gradient via chain rule: df/dtheta = df/du * du/dtheta."""
 79        x_arr = np.asarray(x_batch, dtype=float)
 80        if x_arr.ndim != 2:
 81            raise ValueError("x_batch must be a 2D array.")
 82        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
 83        u_batch = self.policy.value(theta_arr, x_arr)
 84        grad_u = self._grad_u_batch(x_arr, u_batch)
 85        return _theta_grad_from_u_grad(self.policy, theta_arr, x_arr, grad_u)
 86
 87    def value_at_u(self, x_batch: np.ndarray, u: float) -> float:
 88        """Compute mean objective value at a fixed action u."""
 89        x_arr = np.asarray(x_batch, dtype=float)
 90        if x_arr.ndim != 2:
 91            raise ValueError("x_batch must be a 2D array.")
 92        u_arr = np.full(x_arr.shape[0], float(u), dtype=float)
 93        values = self._value_batch(x_arr, u_arr)
 94        return float(np.mean(values))
 95
 96    def mean_acceptance_at_u(self, x_batch: np.ndarray, u: float) -> float:
 97        """Compute mean acceptance probability at a fixed action u."""
 98        x_arr = np.asarray(x_batch, dtype=float)
 99        if x_arr.ndim != 2:
100            raise ValueError("x_batch must be a 2D array.")
101        u_arr = np.full(x_arr.shape[0], float(u), dtype=float)
102        beta_1_x = x_arr @ self.beta_1[: x_arr.shape[1]]
103        logits = beta_1_x + self.beta_2 * u_arr
104        return float(np.mean(_sigmoid(logits)))
105
106    def _value_batch(self, x_array: np.ndarray, u_array: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
107        """Compute objective values for batch of (x, u) pairs."""
108        beta_1_x = x_array @ self.beta_1[: x_array.shape[1]]
109        beta_3_x = x_array @ self.beta_3[: x_array.shape[1]]
110        logits = beta_1_x + self.beta_2 * u_array
111        acceptance = _sigmoid(logits)
112        revenue = self.beta_4 * u_array
113        return acceptance * (beta_3_x - revenue)
114
115    def _grad_u_batch(self, x_array: np.ndarray, u_array: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
116        """Compute gradient w.r.t. u for batch of (x, u) pairs."""
117        beta_1_x = x_array @ self.beta_1[: x_array.shape[1]]
118        beta_3_x = x_array @ self.beta_3[: x_array.shape[1]]
119        logits = beta_1_x + self.beta_2 * u_array
120        acceptance = _sigmoid(logits)
121        d_acceptance_du = acceptance * (1.0 - acceptance) * self.beta_2
122        revenue = self.beta_4 * u_array
123        return d_acceptance_du * (beta_3_x - revenue) - acceptance * self.beta_4

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelBasedObjective(objective.Objective): 
 20@dataclass(frozen=True)
 21class ModelBasedObjective(Objective):
 22    r"""Pricing objective backed by trained ML models.
 23
 24    $$f(u; x) = a(x,u) \cdot (L(x) - (u + 1) \cdot p(x))$$
 25
 26    where $$a(x,u)$$ is acceptance derived from the bundled acceptance classifier,
 27    $$L(x)$$ is the loss term (LinearRegression/XGBRegressor prediction,
 28    or observed ``Y_G_Loss`` when ``loss_source="observed"``), and $$p(x)$$ is
 29    the policy premium extracted from column ``premium_col`` of x.
 30    The policy output ``u`` stays centered at 0, so ``u = 0`` means the baseline
 31    premium multiplier and revenue uses ``(u + 1) * p(x)``.
 32
 33    ``acceptance_model`` expects a raw DataFrame with ``acceptance_state_cols + ["U"]``;
 34    for the canonical 052726 artifacts class 1 is direct acceptance probability.
 35    ``loss_model`` expects a raw DataFrame with ``loss_cols``. When GLM coefficients
 36    can be extracted from the artifacts, value/acceptance calls use the equivalent
 37    array formula instead of repeated sklearn predictions.
 38
 39    If ``u_coef`` is provided for GLM artifacts, it overrides the artifact's
 40    $$d\,\text{logit}(p_{accept}) / dU$$ coefficient in both acceptance values and
 41    analytical gradients. Otherwise the extracted artifact coefficient is used;
 42    unsupported artifacts fall back to numerical central finite differences.
 43
 44    When ``acceptance_floor`` and ``acceptance_penalty_weight`` are both set,
 45    ``value()`` adds a smooth mean-acceptance penalty. When ``lagrangian_lambda``
 46    is set, ``value()`` optimizes the scalarized target
 47    $$J(\theta) + \lambda (\text{floor} - \bar{a}(\theta))$$ while
 48    ``base_value()`` keeps exposing the raw pricing objective $$J(\theta)$$ for
 49    reporting. Direct trust-region constraints are handled at the optimizer level
 50    via ``step_rule="trust-constr"``.
 51    """
 52
 53    policy: Policy
 54    acceptance_model: Any
 55    loss_model: Any
 56    acceptance_state_cols: tuple[str, ...]
 57    loss_cols: tuple[str, ...]
 58    premium_col: int | str = "X_policy_premium"
 59    loss_source: Literal["predicted", "observed"] = "predicted"
 60    observed_loss_col: str = "Y_G_Loss"
 61    u_coef: float | None = None
 62    u_bounds: tuple[float, float] | None = None
 63    acceptance_floor: float | None = None
 64    acceptance_penalty_weight: float | None = None
 65    acceptance_penalty_temperature: float = 0.01
 66    lagrangian_lambda: float | None = None
 67    policy_preprocessor: PolicyFeaturePreprocessor | None = None
 68    policy_feature_cols: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
 69    _fd_eps: float = 1e-4
 70    _eval_counts: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict, compare=False, repr=False)
 71    _cache: dict[object, Any] = field(
 72        default_factory=dict,
 73        compare=False,
 74        repr=False,
 75    )
 76
 77    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
 78        if self.loss_source not in {"predicted", "observed"}:
 79            raise ValueError("loss_source must be 'predicted' or 'observed'.")
 80        object.__setattr__(self, "observed_loss_col", str(self.observed_loss_col))
 81
 82    def _clip_u(self, u: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 83        """Clip u to bounds if set."""
 84        if self.u_bounds is not None:
 85            return np.clip(u, *self.u_bounds)
 86        return u
 87
 88    def reset_eval_counts(self) -> None:
 89        """Reset mutable diagnostic counters for model/objective evaluations."""
 90        self._eval_counts.clear()
 91
 92    def eval_counts(self) -> dict[str, float]:
 93        """Return diagnostic counts for objective and model prediction calls."""
 94        return dict(self._eval_counts)
 95
 96    def _record_eval(self, key: str, rows: int | None = None) -> None:
 97        self._eval_counts[key] = self._eval_counts.get(key, 0) + 1
 98        if rows is not None:
 99            row_key = f"{key}_rows"
100            self._eval_counts[row_key] = self._eval_counts.get(row_key, 0) + int(rows)
101
102    def _record_time(self, key: str, elapsed: float) -> None:
103        self._eval_counts[key] = self._eval_counts.get(key, 0.0) + float(elapsed)
104
105    def _row_count(self, x_batch: Any) -> int:
106        return int(x_batch.shape[0])
107
108    def _x_frame(self, x_batch: Any) -> pd.DataFrame:
109        """Return raw source-space X columns as a DataFrame."""
110        if isinstance(x_batch, pd.DataFrame):
111            if x_batch.ndim != 2:
112                raise ValueError("x_batch must be 2D.")
113            return x_batch.reset_index(drop=True)
114        x_arr = np.asarray(x_batch)
115        if x_arr.ndim != 2:
116            raise ValueError("x_batch must be 2D.")
117        if x_arr.shape[1] != len(self.acceptance_state_cols):
118            raise ValueError(
119                f"x_batch has {x_arr.shape[1]} columns but expected "
120                f"{len(self.acceptance_state_cols)} acceptance-state columns."
121            )
122        return pd.DataFrame(x_arr, columns=list(self.acceptance_state_cols))
123
124    def _cache_key(self, name: str, x_batch: Any) -> tuple[object, ...]:
125        if isinstance(x_batch, pd.DataFrame):
126            return (name, "df", id(x_batch), tuple(x_batch.shape), tuple(x_batch.columns))
127        x_arr = np.asarray(x_batch)
128        return (name, "array", id(x_arr), tuple(x_arr.shape), str(x_arr.dtype))
129
130    def _premium_values(self, x_batch: Any) -> np.ndarray:
131        frame = self._x_frame(x_batch)
132        if isinstance(self.premium_col, str):
133            if self.premium_col not in frame.columns:
134                raise ValueError(f"Missing premium column '{self.premium_col}' in x_batch.")
135            return frame[self.premium_col].to_numpy(dtype=float)
136        return frame.iloc[:, int(self.premium_col)].to_numpy(dtype=float)
137
138    def _observed_loss_values(self, x_batch: Any) -> np.ndarray:
139        frame = self._x_frame(x_batch)
140        if self.observed_loss_col not in frame.columns:
141            raise ValueError(
142                f"loss_source='observed' requires column '{self.observed_loss_col}' in x_batch."
143            )
144        loss = frame[self.observed_loss_col].to_numpy(dtype=float)
145        if loss.shape != (self._row_count(x_batch),):
146            raise ValueError("Observed loss values must have one value per x_batch row.")
147        if not np.isfinite(loss).all():
148            raise ValueError("Observed loss values must be finite.")
149        return loss
150
151    def value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> float:
152        """Compute mean objective value across batch."""
153        start = time.perf_counter()
154        self._x_frame(x_batch)
155        try:
156            self._record_eval("objective_value_calls", self._row_count(x_batch))
157            theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
158            u_batch = self._clip_u(self.policy_value(theta_arr, x_batch))
159            acceptance = self._acceptance_proba(x_batch, u_batch)
160            loss = self._loss_prediction(x_batch)
161            premium = self._premium_values(x_batch)
162            base_value = float(np.mean(self._value_batch_from_components(acceptance, loss, premium, u_batch)))
163            penalty_value, _ = self._acceptance_penalty(acceptance)
164            lagrangian_value, _ = self._lagrangian_adjustment(acceptance)
165            return base_value + penalty_value + lagrangian_value
166        finally:
167            self._record_time("objective_value_seconds", time.perf_counter() - start)
168
169    def base_value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> float:
170        """Return the raw pricing objective without penalties or Lagrangian terms."""
171        self._x_frame(x_batch)
172        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
173        u_batch = self._clip_u(self.policy_value(theta_arr, x_batch))
174        return self._mean_base_value(x_batch, u_batch)
175
176    def grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
177        """Compute theta-gradient via chain rule: df/dtheta = mean(df/du * du/dtheta)."""
178        self._x_frame(x_batch)
179        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
180        u_raw = self.policy_value(theta_arr, x_batch)
181        u_clipped = self._clip_u(u_raw)
182        acceptance = self._acceptance_proba(x_batch, u_clipped)
183        grad_u = self._grad_u_batch(x_batch, u_clipped, acceptance=acceptance)
184        # Zero gradient for samples where u was clipped (subgradient)
185        if self.u_bounds is not None:
186            interior = (u_raw > self.u_bounds[0]) & (u_raw < self.u_bounds[1])
187            grad_u = grad_u * interior
188        grad_theta = _theta_grad_from_u_grad(self, theta_arr, x_batch, grad_u)
189        penalty_value, penalty_scale = self._acceptance_penalty(acceptance)
190        del penalty_value
191        lagrangian_value, lagrangian_scale = self._lagrangian_adjustment(acceptance)
192        del lagrangian_value
193        if penalty_scale == 0.0 and lagrangian_scale == 0.0:
194            return grad_theta
195        return grad_theta + (penalty_scale + lagrangian_scale) * self.mean_acceptance_grad(theta_arr, x_batch)
196
197    def policy_value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
198        """Evaluate policy actions on acceptance-preprocessed features from raw state."""
199        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
200        return np.asarray(self.policy.value(theta_arr, self._policy_features(x_batch)), dtype=float)
201
202    def policy_grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
203        """Evaluate policy Jacobians on acceptance-preprocessed features from raw state."""
204        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
205        return np.asarray(self.policy.grad(theta_arr, self._policy_features(x_batch)), dtype=float)
206
207    def policy_weighted_grad(
208        self,
209        theta: np.ndarray,
210        x_batch: np.ndarray,
211        weights: np.ndarray,
212    ) -> np.ndarray:
213        """Evaluate weighted policy-gradient sum on acceptance-preprocessed features."""
214        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
215        weights_arr = np.asarray(weights, dtype=float)
216        return np.asarray(
217            self.policy.weighted_grad(theta_arr, self._policy_features(x_batch), weights_arr),
218            dtype=float,
219        )
220
221    def policy_input_dim(self) -> int:
222        """Return the processed state dimension seen by the policy."""
223        if self.policy_preprocessor is not None:
224            output_dim = getattr(self.policy_preprocessor, "output_dim_", None)
225            if output_dim is None:
226                raise ValueError("policy_preprocessor must be fitted before theta sizing.")
227            return int(output_dim)
228        feature_dim_fn = getattr(self.acceptance_model, "policy_feature_dim", None)
229        if callable(feature_dim_fn):
230            return int(feature_dim_fn())
231        return len(self._artifact_x_feature_cols(self.acceptance_model, self.acceptance_state_cols))
232
233    def policy_theta_dim(self, state_dim: int | None = None) -> int:
234        """Return theta dimension required by the policy over processed features."""
235        del state_dim
236        return policy_theta_dim(self.policy, self.policy_input_dim())

238    def value_at_u(self, x_batch: np.ndarray, u: float) -> float:
239        """Compute mean objective value at a fixed action u."""
240        self._x_frame(x_batch)
241        u_val = float(u)
242        if self.u_bounds is not None:
243            u_val = float(np.clip(u_val, *self.u_bounds))
244        u_arr = np.full(self._row_count(x_batch), u_val, dtype=float)
245        acceptance = self._acceptance_proba(x_batch, u_arr)
246        loss = self._loss_prediction(x_batch)
247        premium = self._premium_values(x_batch)
248        base_value = float(np.mean(self._value_batch_from_components(acceptance, loss, premium, u_arr)))
249        penalty_value, _ = self._acceptance_penalty(acceptance)
250        lagrangian_value, _ = self._lagrangian_adjustment(acceptance)
251        return base_value + penalty_value + lagrangian_value
252
253    def base_value_at_u(self, x_batch: np.ndarray, u: float) -> float:
254        """Return the raw pricing objective at a fixed action u."""
255        self._x_frame(x_batch)
256        u_val = float(u)
257        if self.u_bounds is not None:
258            u_val = float(np.clip(u_val, *self.u_bounds))
259        u_arr = np.full(self._row_count(x_batch), u_val, dtype=float)
260        return self._mean_base_value(x_batch, u_arr)

262    def mean_acceptance(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> float:
263        """Return mean acceptance probability under the current policy."""
264        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
265        u_batch = self._clip_u(self.policy_value(theta_arr, x_batch))
266        return float(np.mean(self._acceptance_proba(x_batch, u_batch)))

268    def mean_acceptance_at_u(self, x_batch: np.ndarray, u: float) -> float:
269        """Return mean acceptance probability at a fixed action u."""
270        self._x_frame(x_batch)
271        u_val = float(u)
272        if self.u_bounds is not None:
273            u_val = float(np.clip(u_val, *self.u_bounds))
274        u_arr = np.full(self._row_count(x_batch), u_val, dtype=float)

277    def _step_metrics(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, float]:
278        """Return per-step mean metrics for reporter logging."""
279        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
280        u_batch = self._clip_u(self.policy_value(theta_arr, x_batch))
281        acceptance = self._acceptance_proba(x_batch, u_batch)
282        loss = self._loss_prediction(x_batch)
283        premium = self._premium_values(x_batch)
284        revenue = (u_batch + 1.0) * premium
285        return {
286            "mean_acceptance": float(np.mean(acceptance)),
287            "projected_loss": float(np.mean(loss)),
288            "projected_revenue": float(np.mean(revenue)),
289        }

291    def mean_acceptance_grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
292        """Return theta-gradient of mean acceptance under the current policy."""
293        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
294        u_raw = self.policy_value(theta_arr, x_batch)
295        u_clipped = self._clip_u(u_raw)
296        d_acceptance_du = self._d_acceptance_du_batch(x_batch, u_clipped)
297        if self.u_bounds is not None:
298            interior = (u_raw > self.u_bounds[0]) & (u_raw < self.u_bounds[1])
299            d_acceptance_du = d_acceptance_du * interior
300        return _theta_grad_from_u_grad(self, theta_arr, x_batch, d_acceptance_du)

322    def _glm_acceptance_coefficients(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
323        key = ("glm_acceptance_coefficients",)
324        if key not in self._cache:
325            try:
326                from data.loader import extract_glm_acceptance_coefficients
327
328                coeffs = extract_glm_acceptance_coefficients(self.acceptance_model)
329            except (AttributeError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
330                coeffs = None
331            self._cache[key] = coeffs
332        return self._cache[key]

334    def _linear_loss_coefficients(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
335        key = ("linear_loss_coefficients",)
336        if key not in self._cache:
337            try:
338                from data.loader import extract_linear_loss_coefficients
339
340                coeffs = extract_linear_loss_coefficients(self.loss_model)
341            except (AttributeError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
342                coeffs = None
343            self._cache[key] = coeffs

346    def _glm_acceptance_base_logit(self, x_batch: Any) -> np.ndarray | None:
347        coeffs = self._glm_acceptance_coefficients()
348        if coeffs is None:
349            return None
350        key = self._cache_key("glm_acceptance_base_logit", x_batch)
351        if key in self._cache:
352            self._record_eval("glm_acceptance_base_logit_cache_hits", self._row_count(x_batch))
353            cached = self._cache[key]
354            return None if cached is None else np.asarray(cached, dtype=float)
355
356        n_rows = self._row_count(x_batch)
357        self._record_eval("glm_acceptance_base_logit_cache_misses", n_rows)
358        raw_df = self._x_frame(x_batch).loc[:, list(self.acceptance_state_cols)].copy()
359        raw_df["U"] = np.zeros(n_rows, dtype=float)
360        model_df = self._artifact_frame(self.acceptance_model, raw_df)
361        feature_names = list(coeffs["x_feature_names"])
362        if any(name not in model_df.columns for name in feature_names):
363            self._cache[key] = None
364            return None
365        x_matrix = model_df.loc[:, feature_names].to_numpy(dtype=float)
366        coef = np.asarray(coeffs["x_coef"], dtype=float)
367        if x_matrix.shape[1] != coef.shape[0]:
368            self._cache[key] = None
369            return None
370        base_logit = float(coeffs["intercept"]) + x_matrix @ coef
371        self._cache[key] = base_logit
372        return base_logit
373
374    def _glm_acceptance_proba(self, x_batch: Any, u_arr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray | None:
375        coeffs = self._glm_acceptance_coefficients()
376        if coeffs is None:
377            return None
378        base_logit = self._glm_acceptance_base_logit(x_batch)
379        if base_logit is None:
380            return None
381        self._record_eval("acceptance_analytic_calls", self._row_count(x_batch))
382        start = time.perf_counter()
383        try:
384            u_coef = self._effective_glm_u_coef(coeffs)
385            class1 = _sigmoid(base_logit + u_coef * u_arr)
386            if coeffs.get("probability_target", getattr(self.acceptance_model, "probability_target", "churn")) == "acceptance":
387                return class1
388            return 1.0 - class1
389        finally:
390            self._record_time("acceptance_analytic_seconds", time.perf_counter() - start)
391
392    def _effective_glm_u_coef(self, coeffs: dict[str, Any]) -> float:
393        """Return configured GLM beta_u, falling back to the artifact value."""
394        if self.u_coef is not None:
395            return float(self.u_coef)
396        return float(coeffs["u_coef"])

398    def _linear_loss_prediction_from_coefficients(self, x_batch: Any) -> np.ndarray | None:
399        coeffs = self._linear_loss_coefficients()
400        if coeffs is None:
401            return None
402        raw_df = self._x_frame(x_batch).loc[:, list(self.loss_cols)].copy()
403        model_df = self._artifact_frame(self.loss_model, raw_df)
404        feature_names = list(coeffs["x_feature_names"])
405        if any(name not in model_df.columns for name in feature_names):
406            return None
407        x_matrix = model_df.loc[:, feature_names].to_numpy(dtype=float)
408        coef = np.asarray(coeffs["x_coef"], dtype=float)
409        if x_matrix.shape[1] != coef.shape[0]:
410            return None
411        self._record_eval("loss_analytic_calls", self._row_count(x_batch))
412        start = time.perf_counter()
413        try:
414            return float(coeffs["intercept"]) + x_matrix @ coef
415        finally:
416            self._record_time("loss_analytic_seconds", time.perf_counter() - start)

418    def _policy_features(self, x_batch: Any) -> np.ndarray:
419        """Return the acceptance-side processed features used by the policy."""
420        key = self._cache_key("policy_features", x_batch)
421        cached = self._cache.get(key)
422        if cached is not None:
423            self._record_eval("policy_features_cache_hits", self._row_count(x_batch))
424            return np.asarray(cached, dtype=float)
425        self._record_eval("policy_features_cache_misses", self._row_count(x_batch))
426        raw_df = self._x_frame(x_batch)
427        if self.policy_preprocessor is not None:
428            if self.policy_feature_cols is None:
429                x_feature_cols = self._artifact_x_feature_cols(self.acceptance_model, self.acceptance_state_cols)
430                state_df = raw_df.loc[:, list(x_feature_cols)].copy()
431                preprocessor = self._artifact_preprocessor(self.acceptance_model)
432                base_features = state_df.to_numpy(dtype=float) if preprocessor is None else np.asarray(preprocessor.transform(state_df), dtype=float)
433            else:
434                policy_cols = self.policy_feature_cols
435                missing = [col for col in policy_cols if col not in raw_df.columns]
436                if missing:
437                    raise ValueError(f"Missing policy feature columns: {missing}")
438                base_features = raw_df.loc[:, list(policy_cols)].to_numpy(dtype=float)
439            features = self.policy_preprocessor.transform(base_features)
440        else:
441            x_feature_cols = self._artifact_x_feature_cols(self.acceptance_model, self.acceptance_state_cols)
442            state_df = raw_df.loc[:, list(x_feature_cols)].copy()
443            preprocessor = self._artifact_preprocessor(self.acceptance_model)
444            if preprocessor is None:
445                features = state_df.to_numpy(dtype=float)
446            else:
447                processed = preprocessor.transform(state_df)
448                features = np.asarray(processed, dtype=float)
449        features_arr = np.asarray(features, dtype=float)
450        self._cache[key] = features_arr
451        return features_arr

453    def _acceptance_model_class1_proba(self, x_batch: Any, u_arr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
454        """Call classifier and return class-1 probability, shape (n,)."""
455        raw_df = self._x_frame(x_batch).loc[:, list(self.acceptance_state_cols)].copy()
456        raw_df["U"] = np.asarray(u_arr, dtype=float)
457        model_df = self._artifact_frame(self.acceptance_model, raw_df)
458        model = self._artifact_model(self.acceptance_model)
459        self._record_eval("acceptance_predict_calls", self._row_count(x_batch))
460        start = time.perf_counter()

466    def _acceptance_proba(self, x_batch: Any, u_arr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
467        """Return acceptance probability for policy-generated actions."""
468        analytical = self._glm_acceptance_proba(x_batch, u_arr)
469        if analytical is not None:
470            return analytical
471        class1 = self._acceptance_model_class1_proba(x_batch, u_arr)
472        if getattr(self.acceptance_model, "probability_target", "churn") == "acceptance":
473            return class1
474        return 1.0 - class1

476    def _loss_prediction(self, x_batch: Any) -> np.ndarray:
477        """Return loss-model predictions or observed losses. Returns shape (n,)."""
478        if self.loss_source == "observed":
479            self._record_eval("observed_loss_calls", self._row_count(x_batch))
480            return self._observed_loss_values(x_batch)
481        key = self._cache_key("loss_prediction", x_batch)
482        cached = self._cache.get(key)
483        if cached is not None:
484            self._record_eval("loss_prediction_cache_hits", self._row_count(x_batch))
485            return np.asarray(cached, dtype=float)
486        self._record_eval("loss_prediction_cache_misses", self._row_count(x_batch))
487        analytical = self._linear_loss_prediction_from_coefficients(x_batch)
488        if analytical is not None:
489            self._cache[key] = analytical
490            return analytical
491        raw_df = self._x_frame(x_batch).loc[:, list(self.loss_cols)].copy()
492        model_df = self._artifact_frame(self.loss_model, raw_df)
493        model = self._artifact_model(self.loss_model)
494        self._record_eval("loss_predict_calls", self._row_count(x_batch))
495        start = time.perf_counter()
496        try:
497            prediction = np.asarray(model.predict(model_df), dtype=float)
498        finally:
499            self._record_time("loss_predict_seconds", time.perf_counter() - start)
500        self._cache[key] = prediction
501        return prediction

503    def _value_batch(self, x_batch: Any, u_arr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
504        """Compute per-sample objective values."""
505        acceptance = self._acceptance_proba(x_batch, u_arr)
506        loss = self._loss_prediction(x_batch)
507        premium = self._premium_values(x_batch)
508        return self._value_batch_from_components(acceptance, loss, premium, u_arr)
509
510    def _value_batch_from_components(
511        self,
512        acceptance: np.ndarray,
513        loss: np.ndarray,
514        premium: np.ndarray,
515        u_arr: np.ndarray,
516    ) -> np.ndarray:
517        """Compute per-sample objective values from already materialized components."""
518        revenue = (u_arr + 1.0) * premium
519        return acceptance * (loss - revenue)
520
521    def _d_acceptance_du_batch(
522        self,
523        x_batch: Any,
524        u_arr: np.ndarray,
525        *,
526        acceptance: np.ndarray | None = None,
527    ) -> np.ndarray:
528        """Compute d acceptance / du for each sample."""
529        acceptance_arr = (
530            np.asarray(acceptance, dtype=float)
531            if acceptance is not None
532            else self._acceptance_proba(x_batch, u_arr)
533        )
534        u_coef = self.u_coef
535        probability_target = getattr(self.acceptance_model, "probability_target", "acceptance")
536        if u_coef is None:
537            coeffs = self._glm_acceptance_coefficients()
538            if coeffs is not None:
539                u_coef = self._effective_glm_u_coef(coeffs)
540                probability_target = coeffs.get("probability_target", probability_target)
541        if u_coef is not None:
542            sign = 1.0 if probability_target == "acceptance" else -1.0
543            return sign * acceptance_arr * (1.0 - acceptance_arr) * u_coef
544        eps = self._fd_eps
545        a_plus = self._acceptance_proba(x_batch, u_arr + eps)
546        a_minus = self._acceptance_proba(x_batch, u_arr - eps)
547        return (a_plus - a_minus) / (2.0 * eps)
548
549    def _mean_base_value(self, x_batch: Any, u_arr: np.ndarray) -> float:
550        """Return the raw mean pricing objective for a fixed batch of actions."""
551        return float(np.mean(self._value_batch(x_batch, u_arr)))
552
553    def _acceptance_penalty(self, acceptance: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
554        """Return ``(penalty_value, d penalty / d mean_acceptance)``."""
555        if self.acceptance_floor is None or self.acceptance_penalty_weight is None:
556            return 0.0, 0.0
557        mean_acceptance = float(np.mean(acceptance))
558        gap = float(self.acceptance_floor) - mean_acceptance
559        temp = float(self.acceptance_penalty_temperature)
560        scaled_gap = gap / temp
561        soft_gap = temp * float(np.logaddexp(0.0, scaled_gap))
562        sigmoid_gap = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-scaled_gap))
563        weight = float(self.acceptance_penalty_weight)
564        penalty_value = weight * soft_gap * soft_gap
565        penalty_grad_mean = -2.0 * weight * soft_gap * sigmoid_gap
566        return penalty_value, penalty_grad_mean
567
568    def _lagrangian_adjustment(self, acceptance: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
569        """Return ``(lagrangian_value, d lagrangian / d mean_acceptance)``."""
570        if self.acceptance_floor is None or self.lagrangian_lambda is None:
571            return 0.0, 0.0
572        mean_acceptance = float(np.mean(acceptance))
573        lambda_value = float(self.lagrangian_lambda)
574        value = lambda_value * (float(self.acceptance_floor) - mean_acceptance)
575        return value, -lambda_value
576
577    def _grad_u_batch(
578        self,
579        x_batch: Any,
580        u_arr: np.ndarray,
581        *,
582        acceptance: np.ndarray | None = None,
583    ) -> np.ndarray:
584        """Compute df/du for each sample."""
585        acceptance_arr = (
586            np.asarray(acceptance, dtype=float)
587            if acceptance is not None
588            else self._acceptance_proba(x_batch, u_arr)
589        )
590        loss = self._loss_prediction(x_batch)
591        premium = self._premium_values(x_batch)
592        revenue = (u_arr + 1.0) * premium
593
594        d_acceptance_du = self._d_acceptance_du_batch(x_batch, u_arr, acceptance=acceptance_arr)
595        return d_acceptance_du * (loss - revenue) - acceptance_arr * premium

Pricing objective backed by trained ML models.

$$f(u; x) = a(x,u) \cdot (L(x) - (u + 1) \cdot p(x))$$

where $$a(x,u)$$ is acceptance derived from the bundled acceptance classifier, $$L(x)$$ is the loss term (LinearRegression/XGBRegressor prediction, or observed Y_G_Loss when loss_source="observed"), and $$p(x)$$ is the policy premium extracted from column premium_col of x. The policy output u stays centered at 0, so u = 0 means the baseline premium multiplier and revenue uses (u + 1) * p(x).

acceptance_model expects a raw DataFrame with acceptance_state_cols + ["U"]; for the canonical 052726 artifacts class 1 is direct acceptance probability. loss_model expects a raw DataFrame with loss_cols. When GLM coefficients can be extracted from the artifacts, value/acceptance calls use the equivalent array formula instead of repeated sklearn predictions.

If u_coef is provided for GLM artifacts, it overrides the artifact's $$d\,\text{logit}(p_{accept}) / dU$$ coefficient in both acceptance values and analytical gradients. Otherwise the extracted artifact coefficient is used; unsupported artifacts fall back to numerical central finite differences.

When acceptance_floor and acceptance_penalty_weight are both set, value() adds a smooth mean-acceptance penalty. When lagrangian_lambda is set, value() optimizes the scalarized target $$J(\theta) + \lambda (\text{floor} - \bar{a}(\theta))$$ while base_value() keeps exposing the raw pricing objective $$J(\theta)$$ for reporting. Direct trust-region constraints are handled at the optimizer level via step_rule="trust-constr".

def value(self, theta: numpy.ndarray, x_batch: numpy.ndarray) -> float: 
151    def value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> float:
152        """Compute mean objective value across batch."""
153        start = time.perf_counter()
154        self._x_frame(x_batch)
155        try:
156            self._record_eval("objective_value_calls", self._row_count(x_batch))
157            theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)

161            premium = self._premium_values(x_batch)

163            penalty_value, _ = self._acceptance_penalty(acceptance)

def base_value(self, theta: numpy.ndarray, x_batch: numpy.ndarray) -> float: 
169    def base_value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> float:
170        """Return the raw pricing objective without penalties or Lagrangian terms."""
171        self._x_frame(x_batch)
172        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)

Return the raw pricing objective without penalties or Lagrangian terms.

def grad(self, theta: numpy.ndarray, x_batch: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray: 
176    def grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
177        """Compute theta-gradient via chain rule: df/dtheta = mean(df/du * du/dtheta)."""
178        self._x_frame(x_batch)
179        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
180        u_raw = self.policy_value(theta_arr, x_batch)
181        u_clipped = self._clip_u(u_raw)
182        acceptance = self._acceptance_proba(x_batch, u_clipped)
183        grad_u = self._grad_u_batch(x_batch, u_clipped, acceptance=acceptance)
184        # Zero gradient for samples where u was clipped (subgradient)
185        if self.u_bounds is not None:
186            interior = (u_raw > self.u_bounds[0]) & (u_raw < self.u_bounds[1])
187            grad_u = grad_u * interior
188        grad_theta = _theta_grad_from_u_grad(self, theta_arr, x_batch, grad_u)
189        penalty_value, penalty_scale = self._acceptance_penalty(acceptance)
190        del penalty_value
191        lagrangian_value, lagrangian_scale = self._lagrangian_adjustment(acceptance)
192        del lagrangian_value
193        if penalty_scale == 0.0 and lagrangian_scale == 0.0:
194            return grad_theta
195        return grad_theta + (penalty_scale + lagrangian_scale) * self.mean_acceptance_grad(theta_arr, x_batch)

class PlantedLogisticObjective(objective.Objective): 
 16@dataclass(frozen=True)
 17class PlantedLogisticObjective(Objective):
 18    """Convex logistic objective with known optimum $$u^*$$ for algorithm validation.
 19
 20    $$L(u; x) = \\log(1 + e^z) - p^*(x) z$$ where $$z = \\alpha u + \\beta^\\top x + b$$.
 21    """
 22
 23    policy: Policy
 24    alpha: float
 25    beta: np.ndarray
 26    bias: float
 27    u_star: float
 28
 29    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
 30        alpha = float(self.alpha)
 31        beta = np.asarray(self.beta, dtype=float)
 32        bias = float(self.bias)
 33        u_star = float(self.u_star)
 34        if alpha == 0.0:
 35            raise ValueError("alpha must be nonzero for a unique optimum.")
 36        object.__setattr__(self, "alpha", alpha)
 37        object.__setattr__(self, "beta", beta)
 38        object.__setattr__(self, "bias", bias)
 39        object.__setattr__(self, "u_star", u_star)
 40
 41    @classmethod
 42    def from_parameters(
 43        cls,
 44        policy: Policy,
 45        alpha: float,
 46        beta: np.ndarray | Sequence[float],
 47        bias: float,
 48        u_star: float,
 49    ) -> "PlantedLogisticObjective":
 50        """Create objective from parameter values."""
 51        return cls(
 52            policy=policy,
 53            alpha=float(alpha),
 54            beta=np.asarray(beta, dtype=float),
 55            bias=float(bias),
 56            u_star=float(u_star),
 57        )
 58
 59    def optimal_u(self) -> float:
 60        """Return the planted optimal action value."""
 61        return float(self.u_star)
 62
 63    def value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> float:
 64        """Compute mean objective value across batch."""
 65        x_arr = np.asarray(x_batch, dtype=float)
 66        if x_arr.ndim != 2:
 67            raise ValueError("x_batch must be a 2D array.")
 68        u_batch = self.policy.value(theta, x_arr)
 69        values = self._value_batch(x_arr, u_batch)
 70        return float(np.mean(values))
 71
 72    def grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 73        """Compute theta-gradient via chain rule: df/dtheta = df/du * du/dtheta."""
 74        x_arr = np.asarray(x_batch, dtype=float)
 75        if x_arr.ndim != 2:
 76            raise ValueError("x_batch must be a 2D array.")
 77        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
 78        u_batch = self.policy.value(theta_arr, x_arr)
 79        grad_u = self._grad_u_batch(x_arr, u_batch)
 80        return _theta_grad_from_u_grad(self.policy, theta_arr, x_arr, grad_u)
 81
 82    def value_at_u(self, x_batch: np.ndarray, u: float) -> float:
 83        """Compute mean objective value at a fixed action u."""
 84        x_arr = np.asarray(x_batch, dtype=float)
 85        if x_arr.ndim != 2:
 86            raise ValueError("x_batch must be a 2D array.")
 87        u_arr = np.full(x_arr.shape[0], float(u), dtype=float)
 88        values = self._value_batch(x_arr, u_arr)
 89        return float(np.mean(values))
 90
 91    def _value_batch(self, x_array: np.ndarray, u_array: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 92        """Compute objective values for batch of (x, u) pairs."""
 93        beta_x = x_array @ self.beta[: x_array.shape[1]]
 94        z = self.alpha * u_array + beta_x + self.bias
 95        z_star = self.alpha * self.u_star + beta_x + self.bias
 96        p_star = _sigmoid(z_star)
 97        return np.logaddexp(0.0, z) - p_star * z
 98
 99    def _grad_u_batch(self, x_array: np.ndarray, u_array: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
100        """Compute gradient w.r.t. u for batch of (x, u) pairs."""
101        beta_x = x_array @ self.beta[: x_array.shape[1]]
102        z = self.alpha * u_array + beta_x + self.bias
103        z_star = self.alpha * self.u_star + beta_x + self.bias
104        p = _sigmoid(z)
105        p_star = _sigmoid(z_star)
106        return self.alpha * (p - p_star)
