@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PreparedGLMObjective(objective.Objective): 
 91@dataclass(frozen=True)
 92class PreparedGLMObjective(Objective):
 93    """Pure NumPy GLM objective over a ``PreparedGLMBatch.x_array`` matrix."""
 94
 95    policy: Policy
 96    policy_feature_dim: int
 97    u_coef: float
 98    probability_target: ProbabilityTarget = "acceptance"
 99    u_bounds: tuple[float, float] | None = None
100    acceptance_floor: float | None = None
101    acceptance_penalty_weight: float | None = None
102    acceptance_penalty_temperature: float = 0.01
103    lagrangian_lambda: float | None = None
104
105    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
106        feature_dim = int(self.policy_feature_dim)
107        if feature_dim <= 0:
108            raise ValueError("policy_feature_dim must be positive.")
109        target = str(self.probability_target)
110        if target not in {"acceptance", "churn"}:
111            raise ValueError("probability_target must be 'acceptance' or 'churn'.")
112        if self.u_bounds is not None:
113            lower, upper = (float(self.u_bounds[0]), float(self.u_bounds[1]))
114            if lower >= upper:
115                raise ValueError("u_bounds must be an increasing (lower, upper) tuple.")
116            object.__setattr__(self, "u_bounds", (lower, upper))
117        if self.acceptance_penalty_temperature <= 0.0:
118            raise ValueError("acceptance_penalty_temperature must be positive.")
119        object.__setattr__(self, "policy_feature_dim", feature_dim)
120        object.__setattr__(self, "u_coef", float(self.u_coef))
121        object.__setattr__(self, "probability_target", target)
122
123    def _clip_u(self, u: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
124        if self.u_bounds is None:
125            return u
126        return np.clip(u, *self.u_bounds)
127
128    def _arrays(self, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
129        x_arr = _prepared_x_array(x_batch)
130        expected_cols = _N_METADATA_COLS + self.policy_feature_dim
131        if x_arr.shape[1] != expected_cols:
132            raise ValueError(f"x_batch must have {expected_cols} columns.")
133        return x_arr[:, 0], x_arr[:, 1], x_arr[:, 2], x_arr[:, _N_METADATA_COLS:]
134
135    def _acceptance(self, base_logit: np.ndarray, u_arr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
136        class1 = _sigmoid(base_logit + self.u_coef * u_arr)
137        if self.probability_target == "acceptance":
138            return class1
139        return 1.0 - class1
140
141    def _d_acceptance_du(self, base_logit: np.ndarray, u_arr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
142        class1 = _sigmoid(base_logit + self.u_coef * u_arr)
143        sign = 1.0 if self.probability_target == "acceptance" else -1.0
144        return sign * class1 * (1.0 - class1) * self.u_coef
145
146    def _value_batch_from_arrays(
147        self,
148        acceptance: np.ndarray,
149        loss: np.ndarray,
150        premium: np.ndarray,
151        u_arr: np.ndarray,
152    ) -> np.ndarray:
153        revenue = (u_arr + 1.0) * premium
154        return acceptance * (loss - revenue)
155
156    def _grad_u_batch_from_arrays(
157        self,
158        base_logit: np.ndarray,
159        loss: np.ndarray,
160        premium: np.ndarray,
161        u_arr: np.ndarray,
162    ) -> np.ndarray:
163        acceptance = self._acceptance(base_logit, u_arr)
164        revenue = (u_arr + 1.0) * premium
165        d_acceptance_du = self._d_acceptance_du(base_logit, u_arr)
166        return d_acceptance_du * (loss - revenue) - acceptance * premium
167
168    def _acceptance_penalty(self, acceptance: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
169        if self.acceptance_floor is None or self.acceptance_penalty_weight is None:
170            return 0.0, 0.0
171        mean_acceptance = float(np.mean(acceptance))
172        gap = float(self.acceptance_floor) - mean_acceptance
173        temp = float(self.acceptance_penalty_temperature)
174        scaled_gap = gap / temp
175        soft_gap = temp * float(np.logaddexp(0.0, scaled_gap))
176        sigmoid_gap = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-scaled_gap))
177        weight = float(self.acceptance_penalty_weight)
178        return weight * soft_gap * soft_gap, -2.0 * weight * soft_gap * sigmoid_gap
179
180    def _lagrangian_adjustment(self, acceptance: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
181        if self.acceptance_floor is None or self.lagrangian_lambda is None:
182            return 0.0, 0.0
183        mean_acceptance = float(np.mean(acceptance))
184        lambda_value = float(self.lagrangian_lambda)
185        return lambda_value * (float(self.acceptance_floor) - mean_acceptance), -lambda_value
186
187    def value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> float:
188        """Compute mean objective value on a prepared numeric batch."""
189        base_logit, loss, premium, features = self._arrays(x_batch)
190        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
191        u_batch = self._clip_u(self.policy.value(theta_arr, features))
192        acceptance = self._acceptance(base_logit, u_batch)
193        base_value = float(np.mean(self._value_batch_from_arrays(acceptance, loss, premium, u_batch)))
194        penalty_value, _ = self._acceptance_penalty(acceptance)
195        lagrangian_value, _ = self._lagrangian_adjustment(acceptance)
196        return base_value + penalty_value + lagrangian_value
197
198    def base_value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> float:
199        """Return the raw pricing objective without penalties or Lagrangian terms."""
200        base_logit, loss, premium, features = self._arrays(x_batch)
201        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
202        u_batch = self._clip_u(self.policy.value(theta_arr, features))
203        acceptance = self._acceptance(base_logit, u_batch)
204        return float(np.mean(self._value_batch_from_arrays(acceptance, loss, premium, u_batch)))
205
206    def grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> np.ndarray:
207        """Compute theta-gradient via a policy VJP over prepared features."""
208        base_logit, loss, premium, features = self._arrays(x_batch)
209        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
210        u_raw = self.policy.value(theta_arr, features)
211        u_clipped = self._clip_u(u_raw)
212        grad_u = self._grad_u_batch_from_arrays(base_logit, loss, premium, u_clipped)
213        if self.u_bounds is not None:
214            interior = (u_raw > self.u_bounds[0]) & (u_raw < self.u_bounds[1])
215            grad_u = grad_u * interior
216        grad_theta = _theta_grad_from_u_grad(self.policy, theta_arr, features, grad_u)
217        acceptance = self._acceptance(base_logit, u_clipped)
218        _, penalty_scale = self._acceptance_penalty(acceptance)
219        _, lagrangian_scale = self._lagrangian_adjustment(acceptance)
220        if penalty_scale == 0.0 and lagrangian_scale == 0.0:
221            return grad_theta
222        return grad_theta + (penalty_scale + lagrangian_scale) * self.mean_acceptance_grad(theta_arr, x_batch)
223
224    def policy_value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> np.ndarray:
225        """Evaluate policy actions on prepared numeric policy features."""
226        _, _, _, features = self._arrays(x_batch)
227        return np.asarray(self.policy.value(np.asarray(theta, dtype=float), features), dtype=float)
228
229    def policy_grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> np.ndarray:
230        """Evaluate policy Jacobians on prepared numeric policy features."""
231        _, _, _, features = self._arrays(x_batch)
232        return np.asarray(self.policy.grad(np.asarray(theta, dtype=float), features), dtype=float)
233
234    def policy_weighted_grad(
235        self,
236        theta: np.ndarray,
237        x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch,
238        weights: np.ndarray,
239    ) -> np.ndarray:
240        """Evaluate weighted policy-gradient sum on prepared numeric features."""
241        _, _, _, features = self._arrays(x_batch)
242        return np.asarray(
243            self.policy.weighted_grad(np.asarray(theta, dtype=float), features, np.asarray(weights, dtype=float)),
244            dtype=float,
245        )
246
247    def policy_input_dim(self) -> int:
248        """Return the prepared feature dimension seen by the policy."""
249        return self.policy_feature_dim
250
251    def policy_theta_dim(self, state_dim: int | None = None) -> int:
252        """Return theta dimension required by the policy over prepared features."""
253        del state_dim
254        return policy_theta_dim(self.policy, self.policy_feature_dim)
255
256    def value_at_u(self, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch, u: float) -> float:
257        """Compute mean objective value at a fixed action."""
258        base_logit, loss, premium, _ = self._arrays(x_batch)
259        u_val = float(u)
260        if self.u_bounds is not None:
261            u_val = float(np.clip(u_val, *self.u_bounds))
262        u_arr = np.full(base_logit.shape[0], u_val, dtype=float)
263        acceptance = self._acceptance(base_logit, u_arr)
264        base_value = float(np.mean(self._value_batch_from_arrays(acceptance, loss, premium, u_arr)))
265        penalty_value, _ = self._acceptance_penalty(acceptance)
266        lagrangian_value, _ = self._lagrangian_adjustment(acceptance)
267        return base_value + penalty_value + lagrangian_value
268
269    def base_value_at_u(self, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch, u: float) -> float:
270        """Return the raw pricing objective at a fixed action."""
271        base_logit, loss, premium, _ = self._arrays(x_batch)
272        u_val = float(u)
273        if self.u_bounds is not None:
274            u_val = float(np.clip(u_val, *self.u_bounds))
275        u_arr = np.full(base_logit.shape[0], u_val, dtype=float)
276        acceptance = self._acceptance(base_logit, u_arr)
277        return float(np.mean(self._value_batch_from_arrays(acceptance, loss, premium, u_arr)))
278
279    def mean_acceptance(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> float:
280        """Return mean acceptance under the current policy."""
281        base_logit, _, _, features = self._arrays(x_batch)
282        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
283        u_batch = self._clip_u(self.policy.value(theta_arr, features))
284        return float(np.mean(self._acceptance(base_logit, u_batch)))
285
286    def mean_acceptance_at_u(self, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch, u: float) -> float:
287        """Return mean acceptance at a fixed action."""
288        base_logit, _, _, _ = self._arrays(x_batch)
289        u_val = float(u)
290        if self.u_bounds is not None:
291            u_val = float(np.clip(u_val, *self.u_bounds))
292        u_arr = np.full(base_logit.shape[0], u_val, dtype=float)
293        return float(np.mean(self._acceptance(base_logit, u_arr)))
294
295    def mean_acceptance_grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> np.ndarray:
296        """Return theta-gradient of mean acceptance under the current policy."""
297        base_logit, _, _, features = self._arrays(x_batch)
298        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
299        u_raw = self.policy.value(theta_arr, features)
300        u_clipped = self._clip_u(u_raw)
301        d_acceptance_du = self._d_acceptance_du(base_logit, u_clipped)
302        if self.u_bounds is not None:
303            interior = (u_raw > self.u_bounds[0]) & (u_raw < self.u_bounds[1])
304            d_acceptance_du = d_acceptance_du * interior
305        return _theta_grad_from_u_grad(self.policy, theta_arr, features, d_acceptance_du)
306
307    def _step_metrics(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> dict[str, float]:
308        """Return per-step mean metrics for reporter logging."""
309        base_logit, loss, premium, features = self._arrays(x_batch)
310        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
311        u_batch = self._clip_u(self.policy.value(theta_arr, features))
312        acceptance = self._acceptance(base_logit, u_batch)
313        revenue = (u_batch + 1.0) * premium
314        return {
315            "mean_acceptance": float(np.mean(acceptance)),
316            "projected_loss": float(np.mean(loss)),
317            "projected_revenue": float(np.mean(revenue)),
318        }

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class JaxPreparedGLMObjective(objective.Objective): 
 55@dataclass(frozen=True)
 56class JaxPreparedGLMObjective(Objective):
 57    """Fixed-batch JAX GLM objective with a NumPy/SciPy-compatible API."""
 58
 59    policy: Policy
 60    x_array: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch
 61    u_coef: float
 62    probability_target: ProbabilityTarget = "acceptance"
 63    u_bounds: tuple[float, float] | None = None
 64    acceptance_floor: float | None = None
 65    acceptance_penalty_weight: float | None = None
 66    acceptance_penalty_temperature: float = 0.01
 67    lagrangian_lambda: float | None = None
 68    _objective_cache_key: tuple[tuple[int, ...], bytes] | None = field(init=False, default=None, repr=False)
 69    _objective_cache: tuple[float, np.ndarray] | None = field(init=False, default=None, repr=False)
 70    _value_cache_key: tuple[tuple[int, ...], bytes] | None = field(init=False, default=None, repr=False)
 71    _value_cache: float | None = field(init=False, default=None, repr=False)
 72    _acceptance_cache_key: tuple[tuple[int, ...], bytes] | None = field(init=False, default=None, repr=False)
 73    _acceptance_cache: tuple[float, np.ndarray] | None = field(init=False, default=None, repr=False)
 74
 75    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
 76        x_arr = _prepared_x_array(self.x_array)
 77        target = str(self.probability_target)
 78        if target not in {"acceptance", "churn"}:
 79            raise ValueError("probability_target must be 'acceptance' or 'churn'.")
 80        if self.u_bounds is not None:
 81            lower, upper = (float(self.u_bounds[0]), float(self.u_bounds[1]))
 82            if lower >= upper:
 83                raise ValueError("u_bounds must be an increasing (lower, upper) tuple.")
 84            object.__setattr__(self, "u_bounds", (lower, upper))
 85        if self.acceptance_penalty_temperature <= 0.0:
 86            raise ValueError("acceptance_penalty_temperature must be positive.")
 87
 88        design = _policy_design_matrix(self.policy, x_arr[:, _N_METADATA_COLS:])
 89        policy_kind, action_low, action_span = _policy_backend_spec(self.policy)
 90        if policy_kind != "constant" and design is None:
 91            raise ValueError("JAX GLM backend requires a policy design matrix.")
 92
 93        _warn_if_large_prepared_design(design)
 94        base_logit_np = np.asarray(x_arr[:, 0], dtype=float)
 95        loss_np = np.asarray(x_arr[:, 1], dtype=float)
 96        premium_np = np.asarray(x_arr[:, 2], dtype=float)
 97        design_np = None if design is None else np.asarray(design, dtype=float)
 98        design_for_jax = (
 99            np.empty((x_arr.shape[0], 0), dtype=float)
100            if design_np is None
101            else design_np
102        )
103        base_logit_jax = jnp.asarray(base_logit_np, dtype=jnp.float64)
104        loss_jax = jnp.asarray(loss_np, dtype=jnp.float64)
105        premium_jax = jnp.asarray(premium_np, dtype=jnp.float64)
106        design_jax = jnp.asarray(design_for_jax, dtype=jnp.float64)
107        u_coef = float(self.u_coef)
108        sign = 1.0 if target == "acceptance" else -1.0
109        floor = None if self.acceptance_floor is None else float(self.acceptance_floor)
110        penalty_weight = (
111            None if self.acceptance_penalty_weight is None else float(self.acceptance_penalty_weight)
112        )
113        penalty_temperature = float(self.acceptance_penalty_temperature)
114        lagrangian_lambda = None if self.lagrangian_lambda is None else float(self.lagrangian_lambda)
115        u_bounds = self.u_bounds
116
117        def clip_u(u: Any) -> Any:
118            if u_bounds is None:
119                return u
120            return jnp.clip(u, float(u_bounds[0]), float(u_bounds[1]))
121
122        def policy_raw_u(theta: Any, base_logit_arr: Any, design_arr: Any) -> Any:
123            if policy_kind == "constant":
124                return jnp.full(base_logit_arr.shape, theta[0], dtype=jnp.float64)
125            score = design_arr @ theta
126            if policy_kind == "linear":
127                return score
128            return action_low + action_span * jax.nn.sigmoid(score)
129
130        def policy_u(theta: Any, base_logit_arr: Any, design_arr: Any) -> Any:
131            return clip_u(policy_raw_u(theta, base_logit_arr, design_arr))
132
133        def acceptance_from_u(base_logit_arr: Any, u: Any) -> Any:
134            class1 = jax.nn.sigmoid(base_logit_arr + u_coef * u)
135            return class1 if sign > 0.0 else 1.0 - class1
136
137        def action_values_from_u(
138            base_logit_arr: Any,
139            loss_arr: Any,
140            premium_arr: Any,
141            u: Any,
142        ) -> Any:
143            u_clipped = clip_u(u)
144            acceptance = acceptance_from_u(base_logit_arr, u_clipped)
145            revenue = (u_clipped + 1.0) * premium_arr
146            return acceptance * (loss_arr - revenue)
147
148        def action_values_from_u_many(
149            base_logit_arr: Any,
150            loss_arr: Any,
151            premium_arr: Any,
152            u_matrix: Any,
153        ) -> Any:
154            u_clipped = clip_u(u_matrix)
155            class1 = jax.nn.sigmoid(base_logit_arr[None, :] + u_coef * u_clipped)
156            acceptance = class1 if sign > 0.0 else 1.0 - class1
157            revenue = (u_clipped + 1.0) * premium_arr[None, :]
158            return acceptance * (loss_arr[None, :] - revenue)
159
160        def raw_objective(
161            theta: Any,
162            base_logit_arr: Any,
163            loss_arr: Any,
164            premium_arr: Any,
165            design_arr: Any,
166        ) -> Any:
167            return jnp.mean(
168                action_values_from_u(
169                    base_logit_arr,
170                    loss_arr,
171                    premium_arr,
172                    policy_u(theta, base_logit_arr, design_arr),
173                )
174            )
175
176        def mean_acceptance(theta: Any, base_logit_arr: Any, design_arr: Any) -> Any:
177            return jnp.mean(
178                acceptance_from_u(
179                    base_logit_arr,
180                    policy_u(theta, base_logit_arr, design_arr),
181                )
182            )
183
184        def objective(
185            theta: Any,
186            base_logit_arr: Any,
187            loss_arr: Any,
188            premium_arr: Any,
189            design_arr: Any,
190        ) -> Any:
191            value = raw_objective(theta, base_logit_arr, loss_arr, premium_arr, design_arr)
192            acceptance_mean = mean_acceptance(theta, base_logit_arr, design_arr)
193            if floor is not None and penalty_weight is not None:
194                gap = floor - acceptance_mean
195                soft_gap = penalty_temperature * jax.nn.softplus(gap / penalty_temperature)
196                value = value + penalty_weight * soft_gap * soft_gap
197            if floor is not None and lagrangian_lambda is not None:
198                value = value + lagrangian_lambda * (floor - acceptance_mean)
199            return value
200
201        object.__setattr__(self, "x_array", x_arr)
202        object.__setattr__(self, "u_coef", u_coef)
203        object.__setattr__(self, "probability_target", target)
204        object.__setattr__(self, "_base_logit_np", base_logit_np)
205        object.__setattr__(self, "_loss_np", loss_np)
206        object.__setattr__(self, "_premium_np", premium_np)
207        object.__setattr__(
208            self,
209            "_policy_features_np",
210            np.asarray(x_arr[:, _N_METADATA_COLS:], dtype=float),
211        )
212        object.__setattr__(self, "_design_matrix_np", design_np)
213        object.__setattr__(self, "_base_logit_jax", base_logit_jax)
214        object.__setattr__(self, "_loss_jax", loss_jax)
215        object.__setattr__(self, "_premium_jax", premium_jax)
216        object.__setattr__(self, "_design_jax", design_jax)
217        object.__setattr__(self, "_policy_kind", policy_kind)
218        object.__setattr__(self, "_action_low", action_low)
219        object.__setattr__(self, "_action_span", action_span)
220        object.__setattr__(self, "_policy_u_jit", jax.jit(policy_u))
221        object.__setattr__(self, "_raw_objective_jit", jax.jit(raw_objective))
222        object.__setattr__(self, "_objective_value_jit", jax.jit(objective))
223        object.__setattr__(
224            self,
225            "_objective_value_and_grad_jit",
226            jax.jit(jax.value_and_grad(objective)),
227        )
228        object.__setattr__(
229            self,
230            "_mean_acceptance_value_and_grad_jit",
231            jax.jit(jax.value_and_grad(mean_acceptance)),
232        )
233        object.__setattr__(self, "_action_values_from_u_jit", jax.jit(action_values_from_u))
234        object.__setattr__(self, "_action_values_from_u_many_jit", jax.jit(action_values_from_u_many))

236    def warmup(self, theta: np.ndarray) -> None:
237        """Compile and run all JAX callbacks once before timing benchmarks."""
238        self.objective_value_and_grad(theta)
239        self.mean_acceptance_value_and_grad(theta)
240        u_batch = self.policy_value(theta, self.x_array)
241        self._value_batch(self.x_array, u_batch)
242        self._value_batch_many(self.x_array, u_batch[None, :])

248    def _objective_value(self, theta: np.ndarray) -> float:
249        """Return cached objective value for value-only estimators."""
250        key, theta_jax = self._theta_key_and_jax(theta)
251        if key == self._objective_cache_key and self._objective_cache is not None:
252            return float(self._objective_cache[0])
253        if key == self._value_cache_key and self._value_cache is not None:
254            return float(self._value_cache)
255        result = float(
256            self._objective_value_jit(
257                theta_jax,
258                self._base_logit_jax,
259                self._loss_jax,
260                self._premium_jax,
261                self._design_jax,
262            )
263        )
264        object.__setattr__(self, "_value_cache_key", key)
265        object.__setattr__(self, "_value_cache", result)
266        return result

268    def objective_value_and_grad(self, theta: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, np.ndarray]:
269        """Return cached objective value and gradient for ``theta``."""
270        key, theta_jax = self._theta_key_and_jax(theta)
271        if key == self._objective_cache_key and self._objective_cache is not None:
272            return self._objective_cache
273        value_jax, grad_jax = self._objective_value_and_grad_jit(
274            theta_jax,
275            self._base_logit_jax,
276            self._loss_jax,
277            self._premium_jax,
278            self._design_jax,
279        )
280        result = (float(value_jax), np.asarray(grad_jax, dtype=float))
281        object.__setattr__(self, "_objective_cache_key", key)
282        object.__setattr__(self, "_objective_cache", result)
283        return result

285    def mean_acceptance_value_and_grad(self, theta: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, np.ndarray]:
286        """Return cached mean acceptance and gradient for ``theta``."""
287        key, theta_jax = self._theta_key_and_jax(theta)
288        if key == self._acceptance_cache_key and self._acceptance_cache is not None:
289            return self._acceptance_cache
290        value_jax, grad_jax = self._mean_acceptance_value_and_grad_jit(
291            theta_jax,
292            self._base_logit_jax,
293            self._design_jax,
294        )
295        result = (float(value_jax), np.asarray(grad_jax, dtype=float))
296        object.__setattr__(self, "_acceptance_cache_key", key)
297        object.__setattr__(self, "_acceptance_cache", result)

301        """Return JAX objective value on this fixed prepared batch."""

303        return self._objective_value(theta)

305    def base_value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> float:
306        """Return raw pricing objective without penalty or Lagrangian terms."""
307        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
308        theta_jax = self._theta_key_and_jax(theta)[1]
309        return float(
310            self._raw_objective_jit(
311                theta_jax,
312                self._base_logit_jax,
313                self._loss_jax,
314                self._premium_jax,
315                self._design_jax,
316            )
317        )

319    def grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> np.ndarray:
320        """Return JAX objective gradient on this fixed prepared batch."""
321        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
322        _, grad = self.objective_value_and_grad(theta)
323        return grad
324
325    def policy_value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> np.ndarray:
326        """Return policy actions on this fixed prepared batch."""
327        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
328        theta_jax = self._theta_key_and_jax(theta)[1]
329        return np.asarray(
330            self._policy_u_jit(theta_jax, self._base_logit_jax, self._design_jax),
331            dtype=float,
332        )
333
334    def policy_grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> np.ndarray:
335        """Return policy Jacobian, primarily for API parity diagnostics."""
336        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
337        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
338        if self._policy_kind == "constant":
339            grad = np.ones((self.x_array.shape[0], 1), dtype=float)
340            raw_u = np.full(self.x_array.shape[0], theta_arr[0], dtype=float)
341            return self._apply_clip_derivative(grad, raw_u)
342        design = np.asarray(self._design_matrix_np, dtype=float)
343        if self._policy_kind == "linear":
344            return self._apply_clip_derivative(design, design @ theta_arr)
345        score = design @ theta_arr
346        sigma = _sigmoid(score)
347        grad = self._action_span * sigma[:, None] * (1.0 - sigma[:, None]) * design
348        raw_u = self._action_low + self._action_span * sigma
349        return self._apply_clip_derivative(grad, raw_u)
350
351    def policy_weighted_grad(
352        self,
353        theta: np.ndarray,
354        x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch,
355        weights: np.ndarray,
356    ) -> np.ndarray:
357        """Return ``sum_i weights_i * d pi_theta(x_i) / dtheta``."""
358        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
359        weights_arr = np.asarray(weights, dtype=float)
360        if weights_arr.shape != (self.x_array.shape[0],):
361            raise ValueError("weights must have one value per x_batch row.")
362        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
363        if self._policy_kind == "constant":
364            raw_u = np.full(self.x_array.shape[0], theta_arr[0], dtype=float)
365            return np.asarray([np.sum(self._clip_derivative_weights(weights_arr, raw_u))], dtype=float)
366        design = np.asarray(self._design_matrix_np, dtype=float)
367        if self._policy_kind == "linear":
368            return self._clip_derivative_weights(weights_arr, design @ theta_arr) @ design
369        score = design @ theta_arr
370        sigma = _sigmoid(score)
371        raw_u = self._action_low + self._action_span * sigma
372        scaled_weights = weights_arr * self._action_span * sigma * (1.0 - sigma)
373        return self._clip_derivative_weights(scaled_weights, raw_u) @ design
374
375    def policy_input_dim(self) -> int:
376        """Return the prepared policy input dimension before feature mapping."""
377        return int(self.x_array.shape[1] - _N_METADATA_COLS)
378
379    def policy_theta_dim(self, state_dim: int | None = None) -> int:
380        """Return theta dimension for the fixed JAX policy representation."""
381        del state_dim
382        if self._policy_kind == "constant":
383            return 1
384        return int(self._design_matrix_np.shape[1])

386    def value_at_u(self, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch, u: float) -> float:
387        """Return objective value at a fixed action on this fixed prepared batch."""
388        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
389        base_value = self.base_value_at_u(x_batch, u)
390        acceptance = self._acceptance_at_u(float(u))
391        penalty_value, _ = self._acceptance_penalty(acceptance)
392        lagrangian_value, _ = self._lagrangian_adjustment(acceptance)
393        return base_value + penalty_value + lagrangian_value
394
395    def base_value_at_u(self, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch, u: float) -> float:
396        """Return raw objective value at a fixed action."""
397        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
398        u_arr = np.full(self.x_array.shape[0], self._clip_scalar_u(float(u)), dtype=float)
399        return float(np.mean(self._value_batch(self.x_array, u_arr)))
400
401    def mean_acceptance(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> float:
402        """Return mean acceptance on this fixed prepared batch."""
403        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
404        value, _ = self.mean_acceptance_value_and_grad(theta)
405        return value
406
407    def mean_acceptance_at_u(self, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch, u: float) -> float:
408        """Return mean acceptance at a fixed action."""
409        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
410        return float(np.mean(self._acceptance_at_u(float(u))))
411
412    def mean_acceptance_grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> np.ndarray:
413        """Return JAX gradient of mean acceptance."""
414        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
415        _, grad = self.mean_acceptance_value_and_grad(theta)
416        return grad

418    def constraint_margin(self, theta: np.ndarray) -> float:
419        """Return ``mean_acceptance(theta) - acceptance_floor``."""
420        if self.acceptance_floor is None:
421            raise ValueError("constraint_margin requires acceptance_floor.")
422        mean_acceptance, _ = self.mean_acceptance_value_and_grad(theta)
423        return mean_acceptance - float(self.acceptance_floor)
424
425    def constraint_margin_grad(self, theta: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
426        """Return gradient of ``mean_acceptance(theta) - acceptance_floor``."""
427        if self.acceptance_floor is None:
428            raise ValueError("constraint_margin_grad requires acceptance_floor.")
429        _, grad = self.mean_acceptance_value_and_grad(theta)
430        return grad
431
432    def _step_metrics(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> dict[str, float]:
433        """Return per-step metrics for reporter logging."""
434        u_batch = self.policy_value(theta, x_batch)
435        acceptance = self._acceptance_at_u_array(u_batch)
436        revenue = (u_batch + 1.0) * self._premium_np
437        return {
438            "mean_acceptance": float(np.mean(acceptance)),
439            "projected_loss": float(np.mean(self._loss_np)),
440            "projected_revenue": float(np.mean(revenue)),
441        }
442
443    def _theta_key_and_jax(self, theta: np.ndarray) -> tuple[tuple[tuple[int, ...], bytes], Any]:
444        theta_arr = np.ascontiguousarray(np.asarray(theta, dtype=float))
445        if theta_arr.ndim != 1:
446            raise ValueError("theta must be a 1D array.")
447        if theta_arr.size != self.policy_theta_dim():
448            raise ValueError(f"theta must have exactly {self.policy_theta_dim()} elements.")
449        return (tuple(theta_arr.shape), theta_arr.tobytes()), jnp.asarray(theta_arr, dtype=jnp.float64)
450
451    def _clip_u(self, u: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
452        if self.u_bounds is None:
453            return np.asarray(u, dtype=float)
454        return np.clip(np.asarray(u, dtype=float), *self.u_bounds)
455
456    def _clip_derivative_weights(self, weights: np.ndarray, raw_u: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
457        if self.u_bounds is None:
458            return weights
459        interior = (raw_u > self.u_bounds[0]) & (raw_u < self.u_bounds[1])
460        return weights * interior
461
462    def _apply_clip_derivative(self, grad: np.ndarray, raw_u: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
463        if self.u_bounds is None:
464            return grad
465        keep = self._clip_derivative_weights(np.ones_like(raw_u, dtype=float), raw_u)
466        return grad * keep[:, None]
467
468    def _value_batch(self, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch, u_arr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
469        """Return raw per-row objective values for supplied actions."""
470        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
471        u_array = np.asarray(u_arr, dtype=float).reshape(-1)
472        if u_array.shape != (self.x_array.shape[0],):
473            raise ValueError("u_arr must have one value per x_batch row.")
474        values = self._action_values_from_u_jit(
475            self._base_logit_jax,
476            self._loss_jax,
477            self._premium_jax,
478            jnp.asarray(u_array, dtype=jnp.float64),
479        )
480        return np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
481
482    def _value_batch_many(self, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch, u_matrix: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
483        """Return raw per-row objective values for multiple supplied action vectors."""
484        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
485        u_arr = np.asarray(u_matrix, dtype=float)
486        if u_arr.ndim != 2 or u_arr.shape[1] != self.x_array.shape[0]:
487            raise ValueError("u_matrix must have shape (n_evaluations, n_rows).")
488        values = self._action_values_from_u_many_jit(
489            self._base_logit_jax,
490            self._loss_jax,
491            self._premium_jax,
492            jnp.asarray(u_arr, dtype=jnp.float64),
493        )
494        return np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
495
496    def _validate_fixed_batch(self, x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch) -> None:
497        x_arr = _prepared_x_array(x_batch)
498        if x_arr.shape != self.x_array.shape:
499            raise ValueError("JAX prepared GLM objective is fixed to its prepared batch shape.")
500
501    def _clip_scalar_u(self, u: float) -> float:
502        if self.u_bounds is None:
503            return float(u)
504        return float(np.clip(float(u), *self.u_bounds))
505
506    def _acceptance_at_u(self, u: float) -> np.ndarray:
507        u_arr = np.full(self.x_array.shape[0], self._clip_scalar_u(u), dtype=float)
508        return self._acceptance_at_u_array(u_arr)
509
510    def _acceptance_at_u_array(self, u_arr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
511        u_clipped = self._clip_u(u_arr)
512        class1 = _sigmoid(self._base_logit_np + self.u_coef * u_clipped)
513        if self.probability_target == "acceptance":
514            return class1
515        return 1.0 - class1
516
517    def _acceptance_penalty(self, acceptance: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
518        if self.acceptance_floor is None or self.acceptance_penalty_weight is None:
519            return 0.0, 0.0
520        mean_acceptance = float(np.mean(acceptance))
521        gap = float(self.acceptance_floor) - mean_acceptance
522        temp = float(self.acceptance_penalty_temperature)
523        soft_gap = temp * float(np.logaddexp(0.0, gap / temp))
524        sigmoid_gap = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-(gap / temp)))
525        weight = float(self.acceptance_penalty_weight)
526        return weight * soft_gap * soft_gap, -2.0 * weight * soft_gap * sigmoid_gap
527
528    def _lagrangian_adjustment(self, acceptance: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
529        if self.acceptance_floor is None or self.lagrangian_lambda is None:
530            return 0.0, 0.0
531        mean_acceptance = float(np.mean(acceptance))
532        lambda_value = float(self.lagrangian_lambda)
533        return lambda_value * (float(self.acceptance_floor) - mean_acceptance), -lambda_value

343        if self._policy_kind == "linear":
344            return self._apply_clip_derivative(design, design @ theta_arr)
345        score = design @ theta_arr
346        sigma = _sigmoid(score)
347        grad = self._action_span * sigma[:, None] * (1.0 - sigma[:, None]) * design
348        raw_u = self._action_low + self._action_span * sigma
349        return self._apply_clip_derivative(grad, raw_u)

Return policy Jacobian, primarily for API parity diagnostics.

def policy_weighted_grad( self, theta: numpy.ndarray, x_batch: numpy.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch, weights: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray: 
351    def policy_weighted_grad(
352        self,
353        theta: np.ndarray,
354        x_batch: np.ndarray | PreparedGLMBatch,
355        weights: np.ndarray,
356    ) -> np.ndarray:
357        """Return ``sum_i weights_i * d pi_theta(x_i) / dtheta``."""
358        self._validate_fixed_batch(x_batch)
359        weights_arr = np.asarray(weights, dtype=float)
360        if weights_arr.shape != (self.x_array.shape[0],):
361            raise ValueError("weights must have one value per x_batch row.")
362        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
363        if self._policy_kind == "constant":
364            raw_u = np.full(self.x_array.shape[0], theta_arr[0], dtype=float)
365            return np.asarray([np.sum(self._clip_derivative_weights(weights_arr, raw_u))], dtype=float)
366        design = np.asarray(self._design_matrix_np, dtype=float)
367        if self._policy_kind == "linear":
368            return self._clip_derivative_weights(weights_arr, design @ theta_arr) @ design
369        score = design @ theta_arr
370        sigma = _sigmoid(score)
371        raw_u = self._action_low + self._action_span * sigma
372        scaled_weights = weights_arr * self._action_span * sigma * (1.0 - sigma)
373        return self._clip_derivative_weights(scaled_weights, raw_u) @ design

Return sum_i weights_i * d pi_theta(x_i) / dtheta.

def prepare_glm_batch( objective: Any, x_batch: Any, *, row_indices: numpy.ndarray | None = None) -> PreparedGLMBatch: 
321def prepare_glm_batch(
322    objective: Any,
323    x_batch: Any,
324    *,
325    row_indices: np.ndarray | None = None,
326) -> PreparedGLMBatch:
327    """Materialize a GLM-backed ``ModelBasedObjective`` into numeric arrays."""
328    coeffs_fn = getattr(objective, "_glm_acceptance_coefficients", None)
329    base_logit_fn = getattr(objective, "_glm_acceptance_base_logit", None)
330    loss_coeffs_fn = getattr(objective, "_linear_loss_coefficients", None)
331    loss_prediction_fn = getattr(objective, "_loss_prediction", None)
332    premium_values_fn = getattr(objective, "_premium_values", None)
333    policy_features_fn = getattr(objective, "_policy_features", None)
334    if not all(
335        callable(fn)
336        for fn in (
337            coeffs_fn,
338            base_logit_fn,
339            loss_prediction_fn,
340            premium_values_fn,
341            policy_features_fn,
342        )
343    ):
344        raise ValueError("objective must expose ModelBasedObjective GLM preparation hooks.")
345
346    coeffs = coeffs_fn()
347    if coeffs is None:
348        raise ValueError("objective does not expose GLM acceptance coefficients.")
349    if getattr(objective, "loss_source", "predicted") != "observed":
350        if not callable(loss_coeffs_fn) or loss_coeffs_fn() is None:
351            raise ValueError("prepared GLM objective requires linear loss coefficients or observed loss.")
352
353    base_logit = base_logit_fn(x_batch)
354    if base_logit is None:
355        raise ValueError("could not materialize GLM base logits for x_batch.")
356
357    u_coef_fn = getattr(objective, "_effective_glm_u_coef", None)
358    u_coef = float(u_coef_fn(coeffs)) if callable(u_coef_fn) else float(coeffs["u_coef"])
359    return PreparedGLMBatch.from_arrays(
360        base_logit=np.asarray(base_logit, dtype=float),
361        loss=np.asarray(loss_prediction_fn(x_batch), dtype=float),
362        premium=np.asarray(premium_values_fn(x_batch), dtype=float),
363        policy_features=np.asarray(policy_features_fn(x_batch), dtype=float),
364        u_coef=u_coef,
365        probability_target=coeffs.get("probability_target", "acceptance"),
366        row_indices=row_indices,
367    )

Materialize a GLM-backed ModelBasedObjective into numeric arrays.

def prepare_glm_objective( objective: Any, x_batch: Any, *, row_indices: numpy.ndarray | None = None) -> tuple[PreparedGLMObjective, PreparedGLMBatch]:

371    objective: Any,
372    x_batch: Any,
373    *,
374    row_indices: np.ndarray | None = None,
375) -> tuple[PreparedGLMObjective, PreparedGLMBatch]:
376    """Return a prepared NumPy objective and its compact numeric batch."""

387        lagrangian_lambda=getattr(objective, "lagrangian_lambda", None),
388    )

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HeteroskedasticGaussianNoise(objective.ObjectiveNoise): 
 75@dataclass(frozen=True)
 76class HeteroskedasticGaussianNoise(ObjectiveNoise):
 77    r"""Deterministic Gaussian field whose std grows with action distance from ``u_center``.
 78
 79    $$\delta(x, u) = \big(\sigma_0 + \gamma\,|u - u_c|\big)\,\varepsilon(x, u; s)$$ with the
 80    same hash-keyed unit-normal field $$\varepsilon(x, u; s)$$ as the homoskedastic adapter,
 81    so evaluations near ``u_center`` (typically the planted optimum) stay nearly noiseless
 82    while far-from-optimum queries become increasingly noisy. With ``growth = 0`` this is
 83    exactly ``HomoskedasticGaussianNoise(std=base_std)``. The seed is controlled by the
 84    experiment ``noise_seed`` stream through ``with_seed``.
 85    """
 86
 87    base_std: float = 0.0
 88    growth: float = 1.0
 89    u_center: float = 0.0
 90    seed: int | None = None
 91
 92    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
 93        base_std = float(self.base_std)
 94        growth = float(self.growth)
 95        u_center = float(self.u_center)
 96        if not np.isfinite(base_std) or base_std < 0.0:
 97            raise ValueError("base_std must be finite and nonnegative.")
 98        if not np.isfinite(growth) or growth < 0.0:
 99            raise ValueError("growth must be finite and nonnegative.")
100        if not np.isfinite(u_center):
101            raise ValueError("u_center must be finite.")
102        object.__setattr__(self, "base_std", base_std)
103        object.__setattr__(self, "growth", growth)
104        object.__setattr__(self, "u_center", u_center)
105        if self.seed is not None:
106            object.__setattr__(self, "seed", _validate_seed(self.seed))
107
108    def with_seed(self, seed: int) -> "HeteroskedasticGaussianNoise":
109        return replace(self, seed=_validate_seed(seed))
110
111    def std_values(self, u: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
112        r"""Return the local noise std $$\sigma(u) = \sigma_0 + \gamma\,|u - u_c|$$."""
113        u_arr = _validate_u_field(u)
114        return self.base_std + self.growth * np.abs(u_arr - self.u_center)
115
116    def values(self, x_batch: Any, u: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
117        r"""Return deterministic $$N(0, \sigma(u)^2)$$ noise keyed by exact ``(x, u)``."""
118        u_arr = _validate_u_field(u)
119        if self.base_std == 0.0 and self.growth == 0.0:
120            return np.zeros_like(u_arr, dtype=float)
121        if self.seed is None:
122            raise ValueError("HeteroskedasticGaussianNoise requires a seed before evaluation.")
123        return self.std_values(u_arr) * _unit_normal_field(self.seed, x_batch, u_arr)

Deterministic Gaussian field whose std grows with action distance from u_center.

$$\delta(x, u) = \big(\sigma_0 + \gamma\,|u - u_c|\big)\,\varepsilon(x, u; s)$$ with the same hash-keyed unit-normal field $$\varepsilon(x, u; s)$$ as the homoskedastic adapter, so evaluations near u_center (typically the planted optimum) stay nearly noiseless while far-from-optimum queries become increasingly noisy. With growth = 0 this is exactly HomoskedasticGaussianNoise(std=base_std). The seed is controlled by the experiment noise_seed stream through with_seed.

growth: float = 1.0
u_center: float = 0.0

109        return replace(self, seed=_validate_seed(seed))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class NoisyObjective(objective.Objective): 
126@dataclass(frozen=True)
127class NoisyObjective(Objective):
128    r"""Objective wrapper exposing $$\hat{M}(x,u)=M(x,u)+\delta(x,u)$$ values."""
129
130    base_objective: Objective
131    noise: ObjectiveNoise
132    policy: Policy | None = None
133
134    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
135        base_policy = getattr(self.base_objective, "policy", None)
136        if self.policy is None:
137            if base_policy is not None:
138                object.__setattr__(self, "policy", base_policy)
139            return
140        if base_policy is self.policy:
141            return
142        try:
143            updated_base = replace(self.base_objective, policy=self.policy)
144        except TypeError as exc:
145            raise ValueError("base_objective policy could not be replaced.") from exc
146        object.__setattr__(self, "base_objective", updated_base)
147
148    def with_noise_seed(self, seed: int) -> "NoisyObjective":
149        """Return a wrapper copy whose noise is controlled by ``seed``."""
150        return replace(self, noise=self.noise.with_seed(seed))
151
152    def value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: Any) -> float:
153        """Return mean noisy objective value for ``theta`` on ``x_batch``."""
154        theta_arr = np.asarray(theta, dtype=float)
155        base_value = float(self.base_objective.value(theta_arr, x_batch))
156        u_arr = self._clip_u(_policy_value(self.base_objective, theta_arr, x_batch))
157        return base_value + float(np.mean(self.noise.values(x_batch, u_arr)))
158
159    def base_value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: Any) -> float:
160        """Return the wrapped clean objective value used for reporting."""
161        base_value_fn = getattr(self.base_objective, "base_value", None)
162        if callable(base_value_fn):
163            return float(base_value_fn(theta, x_batch))
164        return float(self.base_objective.value(theta, x_batch))
165
166    def grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: Any) -> np.ndarray:
167        """No analytical gradient exists for hash-keyed noisy objective values."""
168        del theta, x_batch
169        raise NotImplementedError(
170            "NoisyObjective has no analytical gradient for M_hat = M + delta(x, u). "
171            "Use value-based zeroth-order estimators, or call base_objective.grad(...) "
172            "to inspect the true non-noisy objective gradient."
173        )
174
175    def value_at_u(self, x_batch: Any, u: float) -> float:
176        """Return mean noisy objective value at a fixed action ``u``."""
177        value_at_u_fn = getattr(self.base_objective, "value_at_u", None)
178        if not callable(value_at_u_fn):
179            raise ValueError("base_objective does not support value_at_u(x_batch, u).")
180        row_count = _row_count(x_batch)
181        u_arr = self._clip_u(np.full(row_count, float(u), dtype=float))
182        return float(value_at_u_fn(x_batch, float(u))) + float(np.mean(self.noise.values(x_batch, u_arr)))
183
184    def base_value_at_u(self, x_batch: Any, u: float) -> float:
185        """Return the wrapped clean objective value at a fixed action ``u``."""
186        base_value_at_u_fn = getattr(self.base_objective, "base_value_at_u", None)
187        if callable(base_value_at_u_fn):
188            return float(base_value_at_u_fn(x_batch, u))
189        value_at_u_fn = getattr(self.base_objective, "value_at_u", None)
190        if callable(value_at_u_fn):
191            return float(value_at_u_fn(x_batch, u))
192        raise ValueError("base_objective does not support value_at_u(x_batch, u).")
193
194    def _value_batch(self, x_batch: Any, u_arr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
195        """Return per-row noisy action-level objective values."""
196        u_values = _validate_u_vector(u_arr, _row_count(x_batch))
197        base_values = _base_action_values(self.base_objective, x_batch, u_values)
198        return base_values + self.noise.values(x_batch, u_values)
199
200    def _value_batch_many(self, x_batch: Any, u_matrix: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
201        """Return noisy action-level values for many action vectors."""
202        u_values = np.asarray(u_matrix, dtype=float)
203        if u_values.ndim != 2:
204            raise ValueError("u_matrix must be 2D.")
205        n_rows = _row_count(x_batch)
206        if u_values.shape[1] != n_rows:
207            raise ValueError("u_matrix must have shape (n_evaluations, n_rows).")
208        value_many_fn = getattr(self.base_objective, "_value_batch_many", None)
209        if callable(value_many_fn):
210            base_values = np.asarray(value_many_fn(x_batch, u_values), dtype=float)
211        else:
212            base_values = np.vstack(
213                [_base_action_values(self.base_objective, x_batch, u_row) for u_row in u_values]
214            )
215        if base_values.shape != u_values.shape:
216            raise ValueError("base objective returned unexpected value matrix shape.")
217        return base_values + self.noise.values(x_batch, u_values)
218
219    def policy_value(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: Any) -> np.ndarray:
220        """Delegate policy action evaluation to the wrapped objective."""
221        return _policy_value(self.base_objective, theta, x_batch)
222
223    def policy_grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: Any) -> np.ndarray:
224        """Delegate policy Jacobian evaluation to the wrapped objective."""
225        grad_fn = getattr(self.base_objective, "policy_grad", None)
226        if callable(grad_fn):
227            return np.asarray(grad_fn(theta, x_batch), dtype=float)
228        if self.policy is None:
229            raise ValueError("base_objective does not expose a policy gradient.")
230        return np.asarray(self.policy.grad(theta, x_batch), dtype=float)
231
232    def policy_weighted_grad(self, theta: np.ndarray, x_batch: Any, weights: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
233        """Delegate weighted policy-gradient evaluation to the wrapped objective."""
234        weighted_grad_fn = getattr(self.base_objective, "policy_weighted_grad", None)
235        if callable(weighted_grad_fn):
236            return np.asarray(weighted_grad_fn(theta, x_batch, weights), dtype=float)
237        if self.policy is None:
238            raise ValueError("base_objective does not expose a weighted policy gradient.")
239        return np.asarray(self.policy.weighted_grad(theta, x_batch, weights), dtype=float)
240
241    def _clip_u(self, u: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
242        clip_fn = getattr(self.base_objective, "_clip_u", None)
243        if callable(clip_fn):
244            return np.asarray(clip_fn(u), dtype=float)
245        return np.asarray(u, dtype=float)
246
247    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Any:
248        if name == "grad":
249            raise AttributeError(name)
250        return getattr(self.base_objective, name)

 94def optimal_u(objective: "Objective") -> float | None:
 95    """Return optimal action u* if the objective exposes it.
 96
 97    For objectives with a known optimum (e.g., PlantedLogisticObjective),
 98    this returns the optimal action value. New objectives can expose this
 99    by implementing an `optimal_u() -> float` method.
100
101    Args:
102        objective: A theta-level objective.
103
104    Returns:
105        The optimal action value if available, otherwise None.
106    """
107    optimal_fn = getattr(objective, "optimal_u", None)
108    if callable(optimal_fn):
109        result = optimal_fn()
110        if result is not None:
111            return float(result)
112    u_star_attr = getattr(objective, "u_star", None)
113    if u_star_attr is not None:
114        return float(u_star_attr)
115    return None
